english: Husaynabad lies near Shantipur in the Bengal delta. Shantipur became known for its handwoven cloth and its association with the Vaishnava teacher Advaita Acharya. By the eighteenth century, its weavers made fine muslin as well as other cotton textiles. Merchants bought Shantipur cloth for markets beyond the town, including Calcutta.
simp_chinese: 侯赛纳巴德位于孟加拉三角洲，靠近尚蒂布尔。尚蒂布尔以手织布和毗湿奴派导师阿德韦塔·阿阇梨而闻名。到十八世纪，当地织工生产细薄的穆斯林布及其他棉织品，商人将布匹售往城外市场，其中包括加尔各答。

english:
Huseyinabad belongs to the inland Anatolian country around present-day Alaca, south of Çorum. The related name Hüseyinova denoted a district whose extent reached beyond the modern town. During the fifteenth and sixteenth centuries it formed part of the administrative landscape associated with Zile, within the Ottoman province of Rum. Before 1574, Hüseyinova had become a separate kaza. Its widest boundaries extended toward Sorgun and south of present-day Yozgat, linking the Alaca country to a much larger network of villages and revenue districts.

The Ottoman settlement also acquired religious buildings that outlasted changes in administrative boundaries. The Eski Mosque was built in 1763 by Ömer Osman Pasha. Together with the Hüseyin Gazi tomb, it forms part of Alaca's inherited Islamic landscape. The history of Huseyinabad thus includes both the changing jurisdiction of an Anatolian district and the patronage that gave its town a lasting place of communal worship.
simp_chinese:
侯赛因阿巴德位于乔鲁姆以南、今阿拉贾一带的安纳托利亚内陆。相关名称Hüseyinova曾指一个范围超过今城镇的行政区。十五至十六世纪，它属于奥斯曼鲁姆省内、与济莱相连的行政地域；1574年以前，Hüseyinova已经单独设为卡扎。其范围最广时向索尔贡及今约兹加特以南延伸，将阿拉贾一带与更大的村落和赋税辖区网络联系起来。

行政边界更动之外，奥斯曼时期的聚落也留下延续至后的宗教建筑。厄梅尔·奥斯曼帕夏于1763年创建老清真寺，与侯赛因加齐陵墓共同构成阿拉贾的伊斯兰历史景观。侯赛因阿巴德的历史由此兼有安纳托利亚行政辖区的变化，以及为城镇留下公共礼拜场所的地方赞助。

sources.title: 346403164 Yozgat'in Kuzey Ilcelerinin Osmanli Tasra Teskilati Icerisindeki Yeri XV ve XVI YuzyilThe Place of Northern Counties of Yozgat in Ottoman Local Administration XV and XVIth Centuries

english:
Huși lies among the vine-covered hills west of the Prut. Vineyards in the district are recorded before the town itself, whose name appears in a letter written by Stephen the Great in 1487. Stephen maintained a princely residence here and founded the Church of Saints Peter and Paul in 1495. Later Moldavian princes also stayed at Huși, drawn by its position and its wines.

In 1574 Prince Ioan Vodă assembled his camp at Huși before his campaign against the Ottomans. The town became an Orthodox episcopal see under Ieremia Movilă in 1598, with Stephen's church serving as its cathedral. The bishopric extended its care over lands east of the Prut as well as the country around Huși. Its court, vineyards and episcopal seat gave the town a place in both the government and religious life of Moldavia.
simp_chinese:
胡希位于普鲁特河以西的葡萄园丘陵之间。当地葡萄园的文书记载早于城镇本身；斯特凡大公于1487年写出的一封信中出现了胡希的名称。斯特凡在此设有亲王居所，并于1495年创建圣彼得与保罗教堂。后来的摩尔达维亚诸公也因这里的位置和美酒而在胡希驻留。

1574年，约安·沃德公爵在发动对奥斯曼的战役前于胡希设营。1598年耶雷米亚·莫维勒统治时，胡希成为东正教主教座，斯特凡的教堂成为座堂。主教区的管辖范围既包括胡希周边，也包括普鲁特河以东的土地。亲王行宫、葡萄园与主教座使这座城镇在摩尔达维亚的政务和宗教生活中占有一席之地。

english: Husinec lies on the Blanice in the foothills of the Bohemian Forest. Recorded in 1291 and raised to town status in 1359, it depended on trade along the Golden Trail, which carried salt and other goods across the mountains. The reformer Jan Hus was born here. After the Battle of White Mountain, many of his followers left Husinec for exile. The estate passed to the Schwarzenberg family in 1655.
simp_chinese: 胡西内茨位于波希米亚森林山麓的布拉尼采河畔。1291年这里已见于记载，1359年升为城镇；当地生计依靠黄金古道的贸易，盐和其他货物沿这条道路越过群山。宗教改革者扬·胡斯出生于此。白山战役后，许多追随他教义的居民离开胡西内茨，流亡国外。1655年，庄园归属施瓦岑贝格家族。

english: Husum stands on the North Frisian coast. When first mentioned as Husembro in 1252 it was inland, but the great storm flood of 1362 inundated the settlement and opened an inlet that became its harbour. A marketplace followed, and the population grew in the late fourteenth century. Husum acquired its first church in 1431 and town privileges in 1603. Like its neighbours on the low coast, it suffered badly in the floods of 1634 and 1717.
simp_chinese: 胡苏姆位于北弗里西亚海岸。1252年首次以胡森布罗之名见于文献时，它尚在内陆；1362年的大风暴潮淹没聚落，冲出一条后来成为港口的水道。市场随之建立，人口在十四世纪末增长。1431年，胡苏姆建起第一座教堂；1603年获得城市特权。与低洼海岸上的邻地一样，它在1634年和1717年的洪水中遭受重创。

english: Al-Hutayb lies among the mountains of Haraz west of Sanaa, in the highlands of Yemen. The village is associated with the Tayyibi Ismaili community and the tomb of Hatim ibn Ibrahim, its third da'i al-mutlaq, who died here in 1199. His resting place became a focus of devotion for followers whose religious ties connected Yemen with communities across the Indian Ocean.
simp_chinese: 胡泰布位于萨那以西的哈拉兹山区，坐落在也门高地。村庄与台伊比伊斯玛仪派社群及其第三任绝对传教士哈廷·伊本·易卜拉欣的陵墓相联系；他于1199年在此去世。信众对其墓地的敬奉，将也门与印度洋彼岸的宗教社群联系起来。

english: Huth is a walled settlement in the northern Yemeni highlands, on the route between the country of Sanaa and Sadah. Its Friday market brought together the inhabitants of surrounding villages. The town stands among the lands of the Usaymat, where cultivated valleys and fortified communities occupy the high ground. Other settlements in the district looked to Huth as a local centre.
simp_chinese: 胡塞是也门北部高地上的一座有城墙的聚落，位于萨那地区与萨达之间的道路上。周五集市汇集周围村庄的居民。城镇坐落在乌赛马特人的土地上，高地间分布着耕作谷地和设防社区，附近其他聚落也以胡塞为地方中心。

english:
Hutton lies in the upland country north-east of Prince George, where the Fraser and Nechako rivers meet and the Rocky Mountain Trench runs through forested hills and the McGregor River valley. This was the homeland of the Dakelh, whom fur traders called Carrier, and their hunting and fishing grounds lay along the rivers and mountain valleys.

The North West Company explorer Simon Fraser founded Fort George in 1807 at the confluence of the Fraser and Nechako rivers, in the homeland of the people whose name means “people of the confluence of the two rivers”. Fort St. James, founded in 1806 on Stuart Lake, was the main post of the New Caledonia district. After the 1821 merger of the two companies, both posts came under the Hudson's Bay Company.
simp_chinese:
赫顿位于普林斯乔治以东北的高地上，弗雷泽河与奈查科河在此汇合，落基山大断谷与麦格雷戈河河谷穿过林地丘陵。这里是达凯尔人的家园，毛皮商人称他们为卡里尔人；他们的狩猎与捕鱼场沿河谷与山间分布。

1807年，西北公司探险家西蒙·弗雷泽在弗雷泽河与奈查科河的汇流处建立了乔治堡，这里是当地原住民的家园，其名字意为“两河汇流之人”。1806年，弗雷泽在斯图尔特湖畔建立了圣詹姆斯堡，它是新喀里多尼亚地区的主要商站。1821年两家公司合并后，两处商站都归哈得逊湾公司管理。

english: The Judith Mountains stand above the plains of central Montana, northeast of the valley of the Judith River. They form one of the isolated mountain groups that interrupt the wide grasslands of the upper Missouri country. The Judith River itself rises in the Little Belt Mountains to the southwest and runs north to the Missouri; in 1805 William Clark named it for Judith Hancock, whom he later married.
simp_chinese: 朱迪思山脉耸立在蒙大拿中部的平原上，位于朱迪思河谷东北侧。这片山地是上密苏里河流域广阔草原上突起的孤立山群之一。朱迪思河发源于西南方的小贝尔特山脉，向北流入密苏里河。1805年，威廉·克拉克以朱迪思·汉考克的名字为河流命名，后来她成为他的妻子。

english: Huwwarin, ancient Evaria, lies on the edge of the Syrian steppe southeast of Homs. Its churches and fortress recall a settlement that was both a military station and a bishop's seat in late antiquity. In the sixth century the Byzantine official Magnus built a church and a wall here. He invited the Ghassanid ruler al-Mundhir to the church's consecration, only to arrest him on imperial orders, provoking a revolt led by al-Mundhir's son. The Umayyad caliph Yazid I later visited Huwwarin and died there; in 1226 the geographer Yaqut described it as a fortress near Homs.
simp_chinese: 胡瓦林即古代的埃瓦里亚，位于霍姆斯东南的叙利亚草原边缘。教堂与堡垒让人想起这处聚落在晚期古代既是驻军地，又是主教座所。六世纪，拜占庭官员马格努斯在此修建教堂和围墙。他邀请加萨尼统治者蒙齐尔参加教堂祝圣礼，却奉皇帝之命将他逮捕，激起蒙齐尔之子领导的反叛。伍麦叶哈里发耶齐德一世后来常到胡瓦林，并在此去世；1226年，地理学家雅库特称它是霍姆斯附近的一座堡垒。

english: Hu County lies south of the Wei River beneath the northern slopes of the Qinling. The Daoist master Wang Chongyang practised here in a self-dug retreat he called the Tomb of the Living Dead, before teaching at nearby Liujiang village. After his death in 1170, his disciples brought his body back for burial. Chongyang Palace grew around his grave and became a principal sanctuary of the Quanzhen school. The complex flourished under the Yuan, and its inscriptions preserve the history of the master and his disciples.
simp_chinese: 鄠县位于渭河南岸、秦岭北麓。道士王重阳曾在此挖穴修炼，称为“活死人墓”，后来到附近刘蒋村传道。1170年他去世后，弟子将其遗体运回安葬。墓旁逐渐兴起重阳宫，成为全真道的重要祖庭；元代宫观兴盛，碑刻记载了祖师与弟子的事迹。

english: The Khüisiin Gobi is a dry basin in western Mongolia, set among the ranges and depressions of the Great Lakes region. Together with the neighbouring Sharga Gobi and Tsetseg Lake basins, it forms an enclosed drainage area in which surface water is scarce. Mountains and broad desert plains give the country a varied relief, while the arid climate makes the springs and seasonal waters of the basin especially significant.
simp_chinese: 辉斯戈壁是蒙古西部的干旱盆地，位于大湖地区的山岭与洼地之间。它与邻近的沙尔嘎戈壁、策策格湖盆地共同构成内流区域，地表水稀少。山地与辽阔的荒漠平原使这里地形多样，而干旱的气候也使盆地中的泉水和季节性水源格外重要。

english: Hvalsey was a Norse farm beside a fjord in southern Greenland's Eastern Settlement. Its stone church stood near a substantial farm complex, where a hall and animal shelters served the household. The church's walls were among the most striking traces of Norse Greenland. In 1408 Þorsteinn Ólafsson and Sigríður Björnsdóttir, visitors from Iceland, were married in the church before a gathering of witnesses. Two priests later certified the marriage at Garðar. Their letter is among the last surviving written records of the Greenland Norse, preserving a glimpse of the community's religious and social life in the fifteenth century.
simp_chinese: 华尔塞是格陵兰南部北欧东部聚落中一座峡湾旁的农场。石砌教堂附近有规模可观的农场建筑，大厅和畜棚服务于庄园家庭。教堂墙壁是格陵兰北欧遗存中最醒目的痕迹之一。1408年，来自冰岛的托尔斯泰因·奥拉夫松与西格丽德·比约恩斯多蒂尔在教堂成婚，许多人在场见证。两位神父后来在加尔扎尔出具婚姻证明。这封文书是格陵兰北欧人留下的最后文字记录之一，让后人得以一瞥十五世纪社群的宗教与社会生活。

english: Hvammstangi lies on the Vatnsnes peninsula beside Miðfjörður in northwestern Iceland. The inlet opens into the broader waters of Húnaflói, with hills and farms along its shores. The peninsula separates neighboring fjords and projects into the northern sea, where seals gather along the coast. Its position gives the surrounding countryside access to the sheltered water of Miðfjörður while facing the colder open waters beyond the bay.
simp_chinese: 华姆斯唐吉位于冰岛西北部瓦特恩斯内斯半岛的米兹峡湾畔。海湾通向更宽阔的胡纳湾，沿岸分布着丘陵和农场。半岛分隔相邻峡湾，伸向北方海域，海豹聚集在岸边。这里的位置使周围乡间能够利用米兹峡湾受庇护的水域，同时面向海湾之外更寒冷的外海。

english: Hvittis, or Huittinen, is an old parish in the river country of Satakunta. Its name appears in a document of 1366 recording a boundary settlement. On Karsatinmäki stands the stone church of Saint Catherine, whose medieval fabric was completed around the end of the fifteenth century. As the congregation grew, the church was enlarged in the late eighteenth century.
simp_chinese: 维蒂斯的芬兰语名为惠蒂宁，是萨塔昆塔河流地区的古老教区。1366年一份划定边界的文件记载了此地名称。卡尔萨廷山上的圣凯瑟琳石教堂约于15世纪末建成其中世纪主体；随着教众增加，教堂在18世纪末扩建。

english:
Hulan grew into a Qing garrison town north of the Songhua. In 1683 the government established eight karun guard posts in the Hulan River basin. The town itself was built in 1734, when more than five hundred Manchu, Solon, Daur and Han-banner troops were transferred from Qiqihar, Boduna and other garrisons. Its early population therefore reflected the different communities serving within the banner system.

Military provisioning soon gave the settlement further substance. A naval battalion was established in 1736 together with the Hengji granary. The following year, Heilongjiang general Nasutu obtained approval to establish official farms at Hulan, recruiting cultivators and their families from the Shengjing banners. Each cultivator was allotted land and two thatched rooms; ten cultivators formed a farm. Forty farms were initially established, increasing to fifty in 1742. These fields, stores and military households formed the foundations of the eighteenth-century town.
simp_chinese:
呼兰在松花江以北逐渐发展为清朝驻防城镇。1683年，清政府在呼兰河流域设置八处卡伦。1734年修建呼兰城，又从齐齐哈尔、伯都纳等驻防地点调来五百余名满洲、索伦、达斡尔和汉军兵丁。城镇早期人口因此包含八旗体系中的多个群体。

军需供应随后推动了聚落发展。1736年，呼兰设置水师营，并修建恒积仓。翌年，黑龙江将军那苏图奏准在这里设立官庄，从盛京八旗招募能耕作的人丁，携家属前来开垦。每名耕作者分得田地及两间草房，十人编成一庄。官庄最初有四十所，1742年增至五十所。田庄、仓储和军户共同构成十八世纪呼兰城镇的基础。

english: Hvolsvöllur lies in the lowlands of southern Iceland, in the country associated with Njáls saga. The saga's farms and feuds belong to a landscape of rivers, pastures and volcanic mountains east of Reykjavík. Among its best-known episodes is the burning of Njáll and his household at Bergþórshvoll, followed by attempts to settle the feud at the Alþing. The story, written in medieval Iceland, preserves a vivid literary vision of the region's early settlers and their disputes.
simp_chinese: 霍尔斯沃德吕尔位于冰岛南部低地，处在与《尼雅尔萨迦》相关的地区。这部萨迦中的农场和仇杀发生在雷克雅未克以东的河流、草地与火山之间。最著名的情节之一，是尼雅尔及其家人在贝格索尔斯霍尔的住所中被烧死，此后人们试图在阿尔辛议会上解决仇怨。这部中世纪冰岛作品生动描绘了早期定居者及其纷争。

english: Hwaju, later known as Yŏnghŭng, was an important centre of Korea's northeastern frontier. From 1258 it served as the seat of the Mongol Ssangsŏng commandery, whose authority extended over neighbouring towns and military posts. In 1356 King Kongmin sent forces to recover the region; local support from Yi Jach'un helped bring the commandery to an end. Yi's son Yi Sŏnggye would later found the Joseon dynasty.
simp_chinese: 和州后来称为永兴，是朝鲜东北边疆的重要中心。1258年起，蒙古设置的双城总管府以此为治所，管辖邻近州邑和军镇。1356年，高丽恭愍王派兵收复该地，当地的李子春予以配合，双城总管府随之被废。李子春之子李成桂后来建立了朝鲜王朝。

english: Hwalbay is the homeland of the Hualapai, whose name means “people of the tall pines.” Their country extends across the mountains and plateaus of northwestern Arizona to the Grand Canyon and Colorado River. The Hualapai used different parts of this landscape in different seasons, combining hunting and gathering with cultivation where conditions permitted. Their ancestors also travelled between the canyon rim and the river corridor. The Franciscan Francisco Garcés visited the Hualapai country in 1776. Hualapai communities maintained close ties with their eastern neighbours, the Havasupai, with whom they shared language and intermarried.
simp_chinese: 赫瓦尔贝是瓦拉派人的故土，其名称意为“高松之民”。他们的地域横跨亚利桑那西北部的山地与高原，延伸至大峡谷和科罗拉多河。瓦拉派人随季节利用不同地带，以狩猎和采集为生，也在条件允许的地方耕种；他们的祖先往返于峡谷边缘与河流地带。1776年，方济各会士弗朗西斯科·加尔塞斯来到瓦拉派地区。瓦拉派社区与东面的哈瓦苏派人关系密切，双方语言相通，并经常通婚。

english: Hwangju stood on the route linking Pyeongan with the Korean heartland, giving the town a role in provincial government, military movements and diplomatic travel. In 1356, King Gongmin restored its status as Hwangju-mok during his campaign to reverse Yuan influence. The Joseon dynasty retained this administrative centre. After wartime disruption, the Hwanghae provincial military headquarters settled at Hwangju in 1601. The nearby Jeongbang mountain fortress was repaired after the Manchu invasion of 1627; troops commanded by Kim Ja-jeom were defeated there during the invasion of 1636. Government and war were only part of the town’s life. Envoys travelling between Korea and China frequently lodged here, and the Taehoru pavilion east of the guesthouse served diplomatic receptions. Hwangju thus joined a fertile agricultural district to one of the peninsula’s important overland corridors.
simp_chinese: 黄州位于平安道通往朝鲜腹地的道路上，兼具地方行政、军事交通和使节往来的作用。1356年，高丽恭愍王在削弱元朝影响的过程中恢复黄州牧建制，朝鲜王朝继续保留这一行政中心。经历战争与机构迁移后，黄海道兵营于1601年落脚黄州。附近的正方山城在1627年后金入侵后得到修缮；1636年再次遭受入侵时，金自点率领的军队在此战败。黄州的历史也不限于官署和战争。往来朝鲜与中国的使节经常在这里停宿，客馆以东的太虚楼承担接待活动。由此，黄州将周边较为肥沃的农业地域，与半岛上一条重要的陆路交通走廊连接起来。

english: Hwasun lies among the hills and valleys of southwestern Korea, south of the mountains around Kwangju. In the early Joseon period its administration was repeatedly rearranged with neighbouring counties. Tongbok was joined to Hwasun in 1405 and separated again in 1416. That year Hwasun was merged with Nŭngsŏng as Sunsŏng, but the two were divided once more in 1418.
simp_chinese: 和顺位于朝鲜西南部的丘陵与河谷之间，北面是光州周围的山地。朝鲜王朝初期，当地与邻县的行政建制屡经调整：同福于1405年并入和顺，1416年再次分开。同年和顺又与绫城合为顺城，1418年两县重新分设。

english: Hymahi, also recorded as Aymai or Guiomae, was an Indigenous village in the river country approached by Hernando de Soto's expedition in 1540. Spanish scouts found it near the meeting of two rivers after the party had crossed a sparsely inhabited region and run short of food. De Soto's men seized the village's provisions and used violence against its inhabitants while seeking directions to Cofitachequi, the chiefdom farther north.
simp_chinese: 希马希是一座原住民村庄，也被记作艾迈或吉奥迈。1540年，埃尔南多·德索托的远征队抵达这一河流地区。西班牙侦察兵在两条河流交汇处附近找到村庄；此前远征队穿过人烟稀少的地区，粮食已近耗尽。德索托的部下夺取了村里的食物，并在询问北方科菲塔切基酋邦的道路时对居民施暴。

english: Hythe is an old Kentish port on the edge of Romney Marsh, one of the original Cinque Ports charged with supplying ships to the English Crown. Its position on the Channel brought trade as well as the danger of raids. Over time the harbour silted and the sea withdrew, diminishing the town's maritime importance. Hythe also suffered a severe fire in 1400, another blow to a community whose fortunes were tied to the changing coast.
simp_chinese: 海斯是肯特郡罗姆尼沼泽边缘的一座古港，也是原初的五港同盟成员之一，承担为英格兰王室提供船只的责任。英吉利海峡的位置带来贸易，也带来袭击的危险。随着港口淤塞、海岸后退，海斯的海运地位逐渐衰落。1400年，一场大火又给这个命运与海岸变化紧密相连的社群带来沉重打击。

english: Hytop stands on the Cumberland Plateau, above the valleys of the Tennessee River basin. The plateau's wooded heights are cut by streams and steep hollows, with caves in the limestone country to the east. At Russell Cave, people sheltered and left traces of their lives over thousands of years. Cherokee communities occupied parts of northeastern Alabama in the late eighteenth century, as conflict and the loss of land elsewhere brought them into the region.
simp_chinese: 黑托普位于坎伯兰高原，俯瞰田纳西河流域的山谷。林木覆盖的高地被溪流和陡峭的沟谷切割，东面石灰岩地带还有洞穴。在拉塞尔洞穴，人们曾栖身于此，留下数千年的生活痕迹。十八世纪后期，战争与其他地区的土地丧失使切罗基人来到这一带，阿拉巴马东北部遂成为他们的家园之一。

english: Ia takes its name from Pơtao Ia, the Jrai King of Water, a hereditary ritual authority in the highlands west of the Cham coast. The Water King belonged to a sacred order that also included the King of Fire. Their powers were associated with the forces upon which crops and communities depended, and their reputation reached beyond the Jrai valleys. Objects preserved by the Water King were regarded as powerful talismans, connected in local tradition with floods and the waters of the land.
simp_chinese: 伊阿得名于嘉莱人的水王波道伊阿，他是占婆海岸以西高地上的世袭宗教领袖。水王属于一个神圣的仪式体系，与火王并列。他们的权能与农作物及村落所依赖的自然力量相联系，声望也超出了嘉莱人的河谷。水王保存的物件被视为有力的圣物，在当地传说中与洪水及大地之水有关。

english: Iagodnoie lies at the meeting of the Yagodny stream and the Debin River in the upper Kolyma country. The Debin runs through the highlands to join the Kolyma, carrying the smaller stream's waters into one of northeastern Siberia's great rivers. Wooded slopes and winding tributary valleys surround the confluence, while the long cold winter leaves the waterways frozen for much of the year.
simp_chinese: 亚戈德诺耶位于科雷马上游地区，亚戈德内溪流在此汇入德宾河。德宾河穿过高地注入科雷马河，将溪水带入西伯利亚东北部的大河之一。森林山坡与蜿蜒的支流河谷环绕交汇处，漫长寒冬使水道一年中很长时间处于冰封状态。

english: Iagorlîc lay where the river of that name joins the Dniester. A document of 1574 mentions an estate there with mills at the river mouth. The valley later became a boundary between the Polish and Ottoman realms: after the Treaty of Karlowitz, surveyors traced the frontier from the Dniester along the Iagorlîc and onward towards the Kodyma. The river thus marked both a local place of settlement and a division between larger powers.
simp_chinese: 亚戈尔利克位于同名河流汇入德涅斯特河的地方。1574年的一份文献提到当地的一处庄园，河口有磨坊。河谷后来成为波兰与奥斯曼领地之间的边界：《卡尔洛维茨条约》后，勘界者从德涅斯特河出发，沿亚戈尔利克河划定边线，再向科德马河方向延伸。这条河既是地方聚居的所在，也是大国之间的分界。

english: Iaguarauna is an Indigenous name associated with Jaguaruna on the southern coast of Santa Catarina. The coast is marked by lagoons, sandy ground and rivers reaching the Atlantic. Large shell mounds, or sambaquis, stand in the region, evidence of ancient communities that lived beside its waters long before Portuguese settlement. Guarani occupation also left traces in the coastal landscape.
simp_chinese: 亚瓜劳纳是与圣卡塔琳娜南海岸雅瓜鲁纳相联系的原住民名称。这里有湖泊、沙地和流入大西洋的河流。当地分布着称为桑巴基的大型贝丘，见证了远在葡萄牙殖民定居之前沿水生活的古代社区；瓜拉尼人的居住也在海岸景观中留下了痕迹。

english:
Iałopháybo, “at the red willows” in the Taos language, is the pueblo that Spaniards called Taos, set on a stream running down from the Sangre de Cristo to the foothills. The Taos people, who speak a northern Tiwa language, settled this valley around 900 CE, and their oldest standing building dates to about 1000. Multistorey adobe houses rose on either side of the stream in the late 1200s and early 1300s. Each autumn, after the harvest, a trade fair here brought peoples of the plains and of the Rio Grande together to trade, and Taos was the most populous of the Pueblo towns in the 1540s.

Members of Coronado's expedition reached it in 1540. Around 1620 Spanish friars oversaw the building of the mission church of San Geronimo, which the Taos people resisted; by 1660 they had killed the resident priest and wrecked the church. In 1680 Taos was the headquarters of the great Pueblo Revolt, and the leader Po'pay made it the capital of the Pueblo republic that expelled the Spanish from New Mexico. Spain returned in the 1690s, and in the following century Taos traded heavily with the Comanche on the plains, even as Blue Lake in the mountains remained the sacred place from which its people say they came.
simp_chinese:
亚洛法伊波在陶斯语中意为“红柳树旁”，就是西班牙人所称的陶斯，位于从桑格雷—德克里斯托山脉流向山麓的溪流边。说北部蒂瓦语的陶斯人约在公元900年前后定居此谷，现存最古老的建筑约建于1000年。13世纪末至14世纪初，多层土坯房屋在溪流两岸陆续建起。每年秋收之后，这里都会举办贸易集市，平原部族与格兰德河沿岸的居民在此聚集交易；16世纪40年代，陶斯是所有普韦布洛城镇中人口最多的一个。

1540年，科罗纳多远征队的成员抵达此地。约1620年，西班牙修士主持修建圣赫罗尼莫教堂，陶斯人对此加以抵制；到1660年，他们杀死了常驻神父，并毁掉教堂。1680年，陶斯是普韦布洛大起义的指挥中心，领袖波佩以它为都，建立起驱逐西班牙人、控制新墨西哥的普韦布洛共和政权。西班牙人于1690年代重返；其后一个世纪里，陶斯与平原上的科曼奇人大量通商，而山中的蓝湖始终是陶斯人自称祖先所出的圣地。

english: Iaremappo lies on the Guiana coast between the mouths of the Maroni and Mana rivers. This is Kali’na country, where the river estuaries meet the Atlantic and sandy shorelines border the low coastal plain. The Kali’na speak a Cariban language and have long inhabited the wider coast of the Guianas. The river mouths give access to both the sea and the forested interior beyond the coastal wetlands.
simp_chinese: 亚雷马波位于圭亚那海岸，马罗尼河和马纳河河口之间。这是卡利纳人的土地，两条河流在此汇入大西洋，沙质海岸与低平的沿海平原相接。卡利纳人使用加勒比语族语言，长期居住在圭亚那更广阔的海岸地带。河口既通向海洋，也通向沿海湿地后方的森林内陆。

english: The coast around Iaremappo lies along the Atlantic shore of the Guianas, near the estuaries of the Maroni and Mana. Kali’na communities inhabit this coastal country, where sandy shores meet river mouths and wetlands. Farther east, the Kourou River also enters the sea. Mud carried from the Amazon moves northwest along the coast in large banks, alternately sheltering and exposing the mangrove fringe.
simp_chinese: 亚雷马波沿岸位于圭亚那大西洋海滨，靠近马罗尼河与马纳河河口。卡利纳人居住在这一海岸地区，沙岸、河口和湿地在此相接。更东面的库鲁河也在这里注入海洋。来自亚马孙河的泥沙以大型泥滩形式沿岸向西北移动，使红树林岸线时而受到庇护，时而暴露于海浪之下。

english:
Iași spreads over the hills above the Bahlui in eastern Moldavia, where the princes kept one of their courts, close to the Polish and Tatar frontier. The German crusader Johann Schiltberger mentions it in 1396, and in 1408 Prince Alexander the Good granted trade privileges here to the merchants of Lviv; the Armenian church is thought to date from 1395. In 1564 Alexandru Lăpușneanu moved the capital of Moldavia here from Suceava, and the market town grew quickly as craftsmen and merchants came from Armenia, Poland, Hungary, France and Venice.

The city burned many times: Tatars set it alight in 1513, the Ottomans in 1538, and in 1650 Cossacks and Tatars, angered by Vasile Lupu's refusal to marry his daughter to Timuș Khmelnytsky, burned it down. Under Lupu it was a centre of learning: the Trei Ierarhi Monastery was built in 1635–39, a school and printing press opened there, and the Synod of Iași met in 1642. The Great Synagogue dates from the 1660s. Dimitrie Cantemir wrote here, and princes founded the Princely Academy in 1707. Greek Phanariot rulers made it a Greek-speaking court, with the Greek Hegemonic School from 1709; the plague of 1734 and fires in 1725, 1735, 1753 and 1766 hit the wooden town, and in 1821 Alexander Ypsilantis raised the Filiki Eteria rising here.
simp_chinese:
雅西铺展在摩尔达维亚东部巴赫卢伊河上的丘陵间，大公们在此设有宫廷之一，靠近波兰与鞑靼人的边境。德意志十字军战士约翰·席尔特贝格1396年提到了它；1408年亚历山大“善良者”大公在此给予利沃夫商人贸易特权，亚美尼亚教堂据信建于1395年。1564年，亚历山德鲁·拉普什内亚努把摩尔达维亚首都从苏恰瓦迁到这里，这座集镇随着来自亚美尼亚、波兰、匈牙利、法国和威尼斯的工匠与商人涌入而迅速发展。

这座城市多次遭焚：1513年鞑靼人纵火，1538年奥斯曼人纵火，1650年哥萨克和鞑靼人因瓦西里·卢普拒绝把女儿嫁给季莫什·赫梅利尼茨基而将它烧毁。卢普治下它是学术中心：三圣教堂修道院于1635至1639年建成，学校和印刷所在此开办，1642年召开雅西会议。大犹太会堂建于1660年代。迪米特里耶·坎泰米尔在此写作，大公们1707年创办了大公学院。希腊法纳尔人统治者使宫廷改说希腊语，1709年起设希腊大公学校；1734年的鼠疫和1725、1735、1753、1766年的大火打击了木结构的城镇，1821年亚历山大·易普斯兰蒂在此发动友谊社起义。

english:
Iatê is associated with the Fulni-ô people of the Ipanema country in Pernambuco. Colonial records called them Carnijós or Carijós; by the mid-eighteenth century the Carnijó name was established. A 1749 account recorded 323 people at the settlement of Ribeira do Panema.

Their land history became entangled with the Crown's policy of concentrating Indigenous communities in mission villages. A royal grant in 1700 provided a square league of land for settlements containing at least one hundred couples. Resistance by Pernambuco's authorities prompted further royal instructions in 1703 and 1705 demanding compliance. These grants later formed part of the documentary basis for Fulni-ô territorial claims. The uncertain date of the community's original concentration does not obscure the eighteenth-century record of an Indigenous settlement confronting colonial administration and competing demands on its land.
simp_chinese:
亚泰这一名称与伯南布哥伊帕内马地区的富尔尼奥人相联系。殖民文献称他们为卡尔尼若人或卡里若人，十八世纪中叶已使用卡尔尼若这一名称。1749年的记载称，潘内马河滨聚落居有323名该族居民。

他们的土地历史与王室将原住民集中到传教村落的政策交织在一起。1700年的王室敕令规定，容纳至少一百对夫妇的聚落应获方一里格的土地。伯南布哥当局不愿执行，王室遂于1703及1705年再次下令要求落实。这些授地文件后来成为富尔尼奥人领地诉求的部分依据。社区最初何时被集中居住仍不确定，但十八世纪的记录已呈现出一个面对殖民管理与土地争夺的原住民聚落。

english: The Iau forest lies in the river country of western New Guinea's Lakes Plain. Iau, also called Turu, belongs to the languages of this plain: its Foi variety is spoken along the Tariku River, while Turu is associated with the Van Daalen. Iau speech makes unusually extensive use of tone, distinguishing words and marking aspects of actions by changes in pitch.
simp_chinese: 伊奥森林位于新几内亚西部湖泊平原的河流地带。伊奥语又称图鲁语，属于这片平原的语言：其福伊语支通行于塔里库河畔，图鲁语支则与范达伦河一带相连。伊奥语广泛使用声调，以音高变化区分词义并标记动作的体。

english: Ibaje lies in the open grasslands of southern Brazil, at the site of Bagé. This was a border country contested by the Portuguese and Spanish empires. After the Treaty of Madrid in 1750, a commission surveyed the frontier near Santa Tecla. Portuguese authorities later granted land for cattle estates, and in 1811 a settlement began to grow around a military camp during the conflict unfolding across the border in the Río de la Plata region.
simp_chinese: 伊巴热位于巴西南部开阔草地上，即巴热所在地。这片边境地区曾为葡萄牙和西班牙帝国争夺。1750年《马德里条约》签订后，一个联合委员会在圣特克拉附近勘定边界。葡萄牙当局后来授予土地建立牧牛庄园；1811年，拉普拉塔地区的冲突在边境另一侧展开，一处聚落开始围绕军营发展。

english: Ibalong was a fishing settlement on the coast of Sorsogon, near the entrance to the waters separating Luzon from the Visayas. Also called Gibalon, it gave its name to the wider Bicol region in early Spanish usage. Local accounts remember the arrival of the friar Alonso Jiménez in 1569 and the baptism of inhabitants here. Coastal raids in the following century disrupted settlements around Sorsogon, and Ibalong did not recover its former prominence.
simp_chinese: 伊巴隆是索索贡海岸的渔村，靠近分隔吕宋与维萨亚斯群岛的水域入口。此地又称希巴隆，早期西班牙人也用其名称指代更广阔的比科尔地区。当地记载称，修士阿隆索·希梅内斯于1569年抵达，并在此为居民施洗。下个世纪的沿海袭掠扰乱了索索贡周边聚落，伊巴隆未能恢复昔日地位。

english: Ibaraki lies in the low country of central Hitachi, near the waters flowing into Lake Kasumigaura. At Fuchū, the old provincial government stood on a plateau between the Tennō and Koise rivers, near temples and the shrine honouring the deities of Hitachi. In the Edo period a branch of the Matsudaira family held lands in Ibaraki and neighbouring districts. Fuchū developed further as the centre of its small domain.
simp_chinese: 茨城位于常陆中部低地，靠近流入霞浦的水系。府中的古代国府设在天王川与恋濑川之间的台地上，附近有寺院及祭祀常陆诸神的总社。江户时代，松平氏一支在茨城及邻郡拥有领地，府中作为其小藩的中心进一步发展。

english:
Ibb stands on a spur of Jabal Badhan in the southern highlands of Yemen, overlooking a mountain valley that turns green with the rains. Terraced fields climb the surrounding slopes. The town occupies a route through the mountains between Aden and Sanaa, and travellers and pilgrims have long crossed the passes above its valley.

Ibb was described as a town as early as the tenth century, although later writers also called it a village or fortress. Under local dynasties from the thirteenth to the fifteenth century, it acquired strong walls, an aqueduct, a public bath, mosques and schools. Its closely packed, multistoreyed houses, streets and defences were built of local grey stone, relieved by whitewashed domes. In the eighteenth century the Danish traveller Carsten Niebuhr estimated that the walled town contained some eight hundred houses. Shops, warehouses and inns lined the narrow streets leading from its gate toward the Great Mosque.
simp_chinese:
伊卜坐落在也门南部高地巴丹山的一处支脉上，俯瞰雨季转绿的山谷。梯田攀上周围山坡。城镇位于亚丁与萨那之间的山路上，旅人和朝觐者长期越过山谷两端的山口。

早在十世纪，伊卜已被称作城镇，虽然后来的作者也称它为村庄或堡垒。十三至十五世纪地方王朝统治期间，城镇修建坚固城墙、引水设施、公共浴室、清真寺和学校。密集的多层住宅、街道和防御工事使用当地灰石建造，白色穹顶点缀其间。十八世纪，丹麦旅行家卡斯滕·尼布尔估计城墙内约有八百户房屋。店铺、仓库和旅店排列在从城门通往大清真寺的狭窄街道旁。

english: The Breede River valley lies beyond the mountain barrier east of the Cape. San hunters and Khoekhoe livestock keepers lived here before colonial farms spread into the valley. The Khoekhoe traded livestock with the settlers, while the smallpox epidemic of 1713 devastated their communities. In 1818 the Cape government purchased farms in the valley for a new administrative centre. The town of Worcester was formally established in 1820, and building plots were sold on its founding day.
simp_chinese: 布里德河谷位于开普以东，隔着一道山地屏障。殖民农场向河谷扩张之前，桑人猎手与饲养牲畜的科伊科伊人生活在这里。科伊科伊人同移民交换牲畜，而1713年的天花流行给他们的社群造成了沉重打击。1818年，开普政府在河谷购买农场，以建立新的行政中心。伍斯特镇于1820年正式设立，建镇当天便售出了多块土地。

english: The Iberá is a great expanse of shallow lagoons, marshes and floating islands in the old floodplain of the Paraná. Mats of water plants drift between the lagoons, while sandy ridges divide the marshes and support patches of woodland and yatay palms. Rain feeds this intricate wetland, whose waters ultimately escape to the Paraná through the Corriente River. Marsh deer and capybaras find shelter among the reeds and open water.
simp_chinese: 伊贝拉是一片广阔的浅湖、沼泽和浮岛，位于巴拉那河古老的泛滥平原。水生植物结成的浮毯漂游在湖泊之间，沙脊分隔着沼泽，上面生长着小片林木和亚泰棕榈。雨水补给这片错综的湿地，最后经科连特河流入巴拉那河；沼泽鹿与水豚则栖息于芦苇和水面之间。

english: The Iberian System is a broad group of mountain ranges crossing the interior of the peninsula towards the Mediterranean. Its southwestern ranges include the Serranía de Cuenca, the Sierra de Albarracín and the Montes Universales. These mountains form an important watershed: rivers rising among their ridges flow towards the Ebro basin, the Atlantic rivers of the interior, and the Mediterranean coast. Limestone heights, valleys and isolated massifs make the range a varied landscape rather than a single unbroken wall.
simp_chinese: 伊比利亚山脉是一组横贯半岛内陆、向地中海方向延伸的广阔山系。西南部分包括昆卡山地、阿尔瓦拉辛山脉和蒙特斯乌尼韦萨莱斯群山。这些山地是重要分水岭：发源于山脊间的河流分别流向埃布罗河盆地、通往大西洋的内陆河流和地中海沿岸。石灰岩高地、谷地与孤立山块构成多样的地貌，而非一堵连续的山墙。

english: Ibi lies on the southern bank of the Benue River in eastern Nigeria. The river links this part of the interior with the Niger basin, while the town stands among communities of the middle Benue valley. Wurbo were recorded as the original inhabitants, with Jukun and other peoples also present in the town's history.
simp_chinese: 伊比位于尼日利亚东部贝努埃河南岸。河流将这一内陆地区与尼日尔河流域连接起来，城镇则处于贝努埃河中游的众多社群之间。记载称沃尔博人为最初的居民；朱昆等人群也出现在当地历史中。

english:
The Ibicuí flows through the grasslands of southern Brazil toward the Uruguay River. In the eighteenth century it became a named line in negotiations between the Portuguese and Spanish crowns. The Treaty of Madrid of 1750 directed the southern boundary toward the river's principal source and along its course, making accurate identification of the headwaters a matter of imperial diplomacy.

The proposed settlement of the frontier also required the transfer of the seven Guaraní mission towns east of the Uruguay to Portugal and the removal of their inhabitants. Resistance to these demands led to the Guaraní War, in which combined Iberian forces defeated the mission communities in 1756. This conflict belonged to the wider mission country north of the Ibicuí, rather than to one riverbank village. The river's historical importance thus lay partly in the gap between a boundary drawn by distant governments and an inhabited landscape of missions, cattle lands and Indigenous communities that could not simply be moved by agreement.
simp_chinese:
伊比库伊河穿过巴西南部草原，汇入乌拉圭河。十八世纪，它成为葡萄牙与西班牙王室谈判中的具名界线。1750年《马德里条约》规定南段边界通向该河主要源头，并沿河道划分，使辨认源流成为帝国外交中的实际问题。

边界安排还要求将乌拉圭河以东的七座瓜拉尼传教城镇交予葡萄牙，并迁走居民。社群抵抗这些要求，最终引发瓜拉尼战争，双方伊比利亚军队于1756年联合击败传教聚落的抵抗力量。这场冲突属于伊比库伊河以北更广阔的传教区，不能视作某个河岸村庄的单独经历。河流的历史意义，部分就在于远方政府所划界线，与传教聚落、牧地和原住民社群构成的实际生活空间之间的矛盾。

sources.title: 969-Obras do Barao do Rio Branco I Questoes de Limites - RepUblica Argentina.pdf

english:
The Ibirapuitã lay within the pastoral frontier contested by Portuguese forces and communities tied to the former Spanish missions. In the eighteenth century, mission Indians maintained cattle estates in the country between the Ibirapuitã, Ibicuí, Quaraí and Uruguay rivers. Portuguese advances in 1801 brought these lands and herds under new claims, followed by disputes over grants and occupation.

Warfare reshaped settlement along the river. After the Inhanduí settlement and chapel were burned in 1816, José de Abreu organised a new settlement on the Ibirapuitã under the authority of the Marquis of Alegrete. A chapel was established there in 1817, giving the future town its name. Indigenous lancers serving under Abreu and their families were gathered around it. Letters from the frontier command show that the creation of this settlement also served military aims and the interests of neighbouring ranchers. Land distribution, religious institutions and the movement of Indigenous households were closely intertwined.
simp_chinese:
伊比拉普伊塔河位于葡萄牙军队与原西班牙传教区社群相争的牧业边疆。十八世纪，传教区原住民在伊比拉普伊塔、伊比库伊、夸赖与乌拉圭河之间经营养牛牧场。1801年葡萄牙势力推进后，这些土地和牛群面临新的占有要求，随之出现土地授予与实际占用的争执。

战争也改变了河畔聚落。1816年因汉杜伊的村落与礼拜堂被焚后，若泽·德阿布雷乌奉阿莱格雷特侯爵之命，在伊比拉普伊塔河畔组织新聚落。1817年这里建立礼拜堂，后来的城镇也以侯爵的封号命名。阿布雷乌麾下的原住民长矛骑兵及其家属被集中安置于周围。边疆司令部的书信表明，建村同时服务于军事目的及邻近牧场主的利益。土地分配、宗教机构和原住民家庭的迁移，在此紧密交织。

english: Ibiza commands a harbour on the island of the same name, its old upper town rising above the Mediterranean. Phoenicians, Carthaginians, Romans, Muslims and Christians all left traces here. In the sixteenth century the Spanish Crown transformed the town's defences to protect this strategic point on the sea routes between Spain and Italy. Italian engineers Giovanni Battista Calvi and Jacobo Paleazzo Fratin designed powerful bastions, enclosing the older streets within a new Renaissance circuit of walls.
simp_chinese: 伊维萨坐落在同名岛屿的港湾旁，老城高处俯瞰地中海。腓尼基人、迦太基人、罗马人、穆斯林和基督徒都在这里留下痕迹。十六世纪，西班牙王室改造城镇防御，以保护西班牙与意大利海上航线上的战略据点。意大利工程师乔瓦尼·巴蒂斯塔·卡尔维和雅各布·帕莱亚佐·弗拉廷设计了坚固棱堡，以新的文艺复兴式城墙环抱古老街巷。

english: Ibo lies among the Quirimbas Islands off northern Mozambique, sheltered by mangroves and coral reefs. Its Swahili-speaking community belonged to a maritime world that linked the East African coast with Arabia and India. Merchants and sailors crossed between the island and the mainland, carrying the goods of the interior into the Indian Ocean trading network. By the late eighteenth century Ibo was an important Portuguese port in the archipelago. The fort of São João Baptista was built at the end of that century to strengthen its defences. Ibo also became a point of departure for enslaved people brought from the mainland and transported overseas, a trade that tied the island's prosperity to coercion and suffering far beyond its shores.
simp_chinese: 伊博位于莫桑比克北部海岸外的基林巴斯群岛，受到红树林和珊瑚礁的庇护。讲斯瓦希里语的社群属于连接东非海岸、阿拉伯和印度的海上世界。商人和水手往返于岛屿与大陆之间，将内陆货物带入印度洋贸易网络。十八世纪末，伊博已是群岛上的重要葡萄牙港口。圣若昂·巴普蒂斯塔堡于该世纪末修建，以加强防御。伊博也是奴隶贸易的出发地，被掳者从大陆带到这里，再被运往海外；岛屿的繁荣因而与远超海岸的强制和苦难相连。

english:
Ibotirama developed from Bom Jardim, a riverside settlement on the left bank of the São Francisco in western Bahia. A record made by Joaquim Quaresma Delgado in 1732 mentions the Bom Jardim farm, one of Joana Guedes de Brito's properties. Local historical accounts associate the village's formation with this estate and the chapel of Nossa Senhora da Guia. Its early history belongs to the cattle-ranching country administered from Santo Antônio do Urubu, later called Paratinga.

Bom Jardim became a crossing place for cattle drovers and pack-train drivers. The farm offered travellers a stopping place beside the river, while river transport connected the settlement with neighbouring districts. Routes also linked it with Urubu and the sanctuary of Bom Jesus da Lapa. Trade, fertile ground and livestock attracted people from elsewhere. Before it acquired the modern name Ibotirama, the small settlement's position at a river crossing had already joined local farming and ranching with the movement of animals, goods and travellers.
simp_chinese:
伊博蒂拉马源于巴伊亚西部圣弗朗西斯科河左岸的博姆雅尔丁聚落。若阿金·夸雷斯马·德尔加多1732年的记录提到同名庄园，它是若阿娜·格德斯·德布里托的产业之一。地方历史将村落形成与这处庄园及圣母指引教堂相联系；这里早期属于以圣安东尼奥杜乌鲁布、后称帕拉廷加为行政中心的牧牛地域。

博姆雅尔丁成为赶牛人和驮运队渡河的地点。河畔庄园供行旅歇息，河运又连接周围地区，道路也通向乌鲁布与博姆热苏斯达拉帕圣地。贸易、肥沃土地和牧牛吸引外地居民。获得伊博蒂拉马这一现代名称以前，这个小聚落已经凭借渡口位置，将地方农业、畜牧与牲畜、货物和行旅的流动联系起来。

english: Ibra is an old town in eastern Oman, known for its market, mosques and fortified houses. Its historic quarter of al-Manzafah contains buildings with inscriptions and decorative work, while watchtowers and forts stand among the town's older structures. Agriculture, trade and crafts have long supported its inhabitants: smiths and silversmiths made tools, jewellery and curved daggers, while other artisans worked leather and palm fronds. Irrigation channels, including Falaj al-Afrit, brought water to the settlement and its gardens.
simp_chinese: 伊卜拉是阿曼东部的古镇，以集市、清真寺和设防宅第闻名。曼扎法旧区有带铭文和装饰的建筑，瞭望塔与堡垒也散布于镇上。农业、贸易和手工业长期养育当地居民：铁匠与银匠制作工具、首饰和弯刀，其他工匠则加工皮革和棕榈叶。包括阿夫里特法拉杰在内的水渠为聚落及园圃引水。

english: Ibrahimabad lies in the Awadh country between the Ghaghara and Gomti rivers, east of Lucknow. The surrounding plain is crossed by smaller streams and dotted with lakes and marshes. During Akbar's reign this part of Awadh was divided among the sarkars of Awadh, Lucknow and Manikpur, linking its settlements to the administration of the Mughal province.
simp_chinese: 易卜拉欣阿巴德位于勒克瑙以东、加格拉河与戈姆蒂河之间的阿瓦德地区。周围平原河溪纵横，散布着湖泊和沼泽。阿克巴统治时期，阿瓦德的这一带分属阿瓦德、勒克瑙和曼尼克布尔三个萨尔卡尔，当地聚落由此与莫卧儿省区的行政体系相连。

english:
Ibri’s old market stood beside a substantial fort, with several entrances, towers and a congregational mosque. The surrounding oasis country joined agriculture to routes across inland Oman. One particularly well-dated defensive site is Al Sulaif, about five kilometres from the centre of Ibri.

Built in 1718 under Imam Sultan bin Saif al-Yarubi, Al Sulaif Fort overlooks its wadi from the foot of Mount Shanboh. A large wall and seven towers protected the settlement. Its position above the eastern approaches to Ibri made it a defensive lookout as well as part of a village known for palms and cultivated resources. Fort, houses, market and gardens occupied the same local landscape, bringing protection of the settlement into close relationship with the routes and productive land around it.
simp_chinese:
伊卜里旧市场旁有一座规模可观的城堡，设有多个入口、塔楼和举行聚礼的清真寺。周围绿洲将农业与阿曼内陆交通相连。其中年代较明确的防御遗址是距伊卜里中心约五公里的苏莱夫。

苏莱夫堡于1718年、伊玛目苏丹·本·赛义夫·亚鲁比统治时期修筑，位于尚布山脚，俯瞰河谷。大型围墙与七座塔楼保护聚落。它居于伊卜里东部来路之上的位置，兼具防御瞭望作用；村庄也以棕榈与农业资源闻名。城堡、住宅、市场和园地共同构成地方生活景观，使防卫聚落与守护周围交通、生产土地紧密相连。

english:
Ibusuki occupied the southern Satsuma Peninsula, where the districts around Ibusuki, Yamagawa and Imaizumi formed part of the Shimazu domains. In 1592 the importance of Yamagawa harbour led to the separation of Fukumoto and Narikawa villages from Ibusuki district to create Yamagawa district. Port administration could thus reshape the boundaries of the surrounding countryside.

A further reorganisation followed in 1744, when the Imaizumi Shimazu house was established as one of the domain's highest-ranking collateral families. Such houses could provide an heir if the ruling Shimazu line lacked a successor. Villages from Ibusuki and Ei districts were assigned to the new Imaizumi territory. In 1754 the family built a residence facing the sea at Iwamoto. The coast consequently became both a setting for harbour administration and a seat of aristocratic authority within the Satsuma domain.
simp_chinese:
揖宿位于萨摩半岛南部，周围的指宿、山川与今和泉地区属于岛津领地。1592年，由于山川港的重要性，福元、成川两村从揖宿郡分出，组成山川乡。港口事务由此直接影响周围乡村的行政划分。

1744年，当地再次调整领地：今和泉岛津家成立，成为藩内地位最高的“一门家”之一。这类旁支家系承担在宗家缺乏继承人时提供后嗣的职责。指宿与颕娃两郡的部分村落被划入新的今和泉领地。1754年，家族又在岩本修建面海的宅邸。半岛海岸因此既是港口治理的场所，也是萨摩藩贵族家系的领地中心；行政区划、宗族继承与具体营建共同塑造了十八世纪的地方格局。

sources.title: 指宿市文化財保存活用地域計画.pdf

english: Ica occupies a fertile river valley amid the deserts of Peru's southern coast. Long before the Spanish town, local communities managed water and desert farmland, combining agriculture with fishing and skilled craft production. The valley entered the Inca realm during the fifteenth century, when settlements helped organize agricultural tribute. In 1563 the Spanish founded Villa de Valverde under Geronimo Luis de Cabrera. Earthquakes repeatedly reshaped the new town: destruction in 1577 prompted a move, and further disasters in the seventeenth century damaged churches and houses. The earthquake of 1687 brought another rearrangement around the main square. Vine cultivation became an important colonial activity, encouraged by the crop's ability to withstand dry conditions. The valley's agricultural wealth sustained both the town and its religious institutions. Independence brought another change in administration. Following San Martin's landing at nearby Paracas in 1820, Ica's council proclaimed independence; in 1825 it became a coastal province separate from Lima.
simp_chinese: 伊卡位于秘鲁南部海岸沙漠中的肥沃河谷。西班牙城镇建立以前，当地居民已经经营水源和沙漠农田，兼营捕鱼与多种手工业。十五世纪，河谷进入印加统治，聚落也承担组织农牧贡赋的任务。1563年，赫罗尼莫·路易斯·德卡夫雷拉建立西班牙人的巴尔韦德镇。地震不断改变城镇形态：1577年的破坏促使居民迁址，十七世纪的多次灾害又摧毁教堂和住宅，1687年地震后，主要广场也重新安排。殖民时期，西班牙人推广较能耐旱的葡萄种植，河谷农业支撑了城镇及修会机构的发展。独立战争随后改变行政归属。1820年，圣马丁在附近帕拉卡斯登陆后，伊卡市政会议宣布独立；1825年，它成为脱离利马管辖的滨海省。

english: Icabaquã is an Indigenous name associated with the Camaquã River, which crosses the grasslands and hills of southern Brazil before reaching the Patos Lagoon. Its swift water drains a region historically inhabited by Guarani and Charrúa peoples. Near the lower river a chapel dedicated to Saint John the Baptist was authorised in 1815, marking the beginning of the settlement later called Camaquã. The river links the interior with the great coastal lagoon.
simp_chinese: 伊卡巴夸是与卡马夸河有关的原住民名称。河流穿过巴西南部草原和丘陵，最终流入帕图斯潟湖；水流湍急的流域历史上有瓜拉尼人与查鲁亚人居住。1815年，下游附近获准建造一座奉献给施洗约翰的小教堂，标志着后来称为卡马夸的聚落开始形成。河流将内陆与广阔沿海潟湖连接起来。

english: The Icafui lived on the mainland of southeastern Georgia, between the Satilla and Altamaha rivers. Closely associated with the Cascangue, they spoke the Itafi dialect of Timucua, also used by the Ibi farther inland. Their neighbours included the Mocama communities of the coastal islands. In the early seventeenth century the Icafui had dealings with the Spanish mission of San Pedro de Mocama on Cumberland Island, though no separate mission was established among them.
simp_chinese: 伊卡富伊人居住在佐治亚东南部大陆的萨蒂拉河与阿尔塔马哈河之间。他们与卡斯坎格人关系密切，使用蒂穆夸语的伊塔菲方言；更靠内陆的伊比人也说这种方言。他们的邻居包括沿海岛屿上的莫卡马社群。十七世纪初，伊卡富伊人与坎伯兰岛的西班牙圣佩德罗·德莫卡马传教站有往来，西班牙人却没有在他们当中设立单独的传教站。

english:
Icalo lies in the broad country between the Bengo and Kwanza rivers, inland from Luanda. The land is a plain of lowland and gentle hills, with the rivers and their floodplains providing water for gardens and grazing. The Kimbundu-speaking people of the district farmed cassava, beans and maize, and fished in the rivers.

Portuguese influence spread inland from the coastal settlement at Luanda during the seventeenth century, and Capuchin missionaries recorded the country between the two rivers at that time. Trade in cloth, salt and captives linked the plain to the coast, and local leaders organised labour and exchange along the river valleys.

The later city of Caxito lies here.
simp_chinese:
伊卡洛位于本戈河与宽扎河之间的广阔地带，在罗安达内陆一侧。这里是低地与缓丘交错的平原，河流及其洪泛区为园圃和牧场提供水源。当地说金本杜语的居民种植木薯、豆类和玉米，并在河中捕鱼。

十七世纪，葡萄牙势力从罗安达沿海聚落向内陆扩展，加布遣会的传教士也在当时记载了两河之间的这片地区。布匹、盐和俘虏贸易把平原与海岸相连，地方首领则在河谷中组织劳动与交换。

后来的卡西托即位于此地。

english: Between the Cyclades and Anatolia, the Icarian Sea surrounds islands including Samos, Icaria and Patmos. Greek tradition placed the fall of Icarus in these waters, after he flew too near the sun while escaping Crete with his father Daedalus. The sea also had a fearsome reputation among ancient sailors: Homer compared its wind-driven waves to a gathering stirred into motion, while Horace associated them with shattered ships.
simp_chinese: 伊卡里亚海位于基克拉泽斯群岛与安纳托利亚之间，萨摩斯、伊卡里亚和帕特莫斯等岛屿散布其中。希腊传说中，伊卡洛斯与父亲代达罗斯逃离克里特时飞得太靠近太阳，坠入这片海中。古代水手也畏惧这里的海况：荷马将风掀起的巨浪比作骚动的人群，贺拉斯则将波涛与破碎的船只联系起来。

english:
The Icelandic Highlands form the volcanic and glaciated interior of an island whose settled communities lived with recurring ash fall and climatic hardship. The wider country's political allegiance passed through the Norwegian and Danish crowns, and Lutheranism was imposed during the sixteenth-century Reformation. Denmark's trade restrictions later limited overseas exchange.

Within this setting the highlands' volcanic activity had consequences reaching far beyond the mountains themselves. The Laki eruption in 1783 devastated livestock and was followed by famine, remembered as the Mist Hardships. More than half the island's animals died, undermining the pastoral economy on which households depended.

Such disasters added to the effects of cold winters and disease, including the smallpox epidemic of the early eighteenth century. Despite repeated hardship, Icelandic communities maintained literary traditions in sacred poetry and rhymed narratives. The empty-looking interior was therefore part of the historical environment of farms around the island: glaciers, lava fields and volcanic ash influenced livelihoods, while distant royal and trading policies shaped the produce available for recovery.
simp_chinese:
冰岛高地构成火山与冰川覆盖的内陆，周围定居社群长期面对火山灰和气候困境。整个岛国的政治归属先后联系挪威与丹麦王室，十六世纪宗教改革又强行推行路德宗。后来的丹麦贸易限制缩小海外交换渠道。

在这样的背景下，高地火山活动产生远超群山的影响。1783年拉基喷发重创牲畜，随后饥荒被记为雾灾。岛上超过一半家畜死亡，破坏家庭赖以生活的畜牧经济。这样的灾害加重寒冬和疾病的影响，其中也包括十八世纪初的天花流行。

尽管反复受困，冰岛社群仍维持圣诗与押韵叙事等文学传统。看似空旷的内陆因此属于全岛农场的历史环境：冰川、熔岩原与火山灰影响生计，远方王室和贸易政策又决定恢复能够利用的资源。高地与沿岸聚落之间，始终存在自然过程造成的实际联系。

english: Ichagarh was the seat of the Patkum estate in the eastern uplands of Chota Nagpur. Its name preserves the word garh, a fortified place, recalling the authority of the local rulers. The estate lay among wooded hills and river valleys between the plateau and Bengal, close to other chiefdoms of Singhbhum. Local dynasties governed these neighbouring territories through their own families and relationships with the communities living in the hills.
simp_chinese: 伊查加尔是乔塔纳格普尔东部高地帕特库姆领地的驻地。地名中保留了意为堡垒的“加尔”，令人想起地方统治者的权威。领地坐落在高原与孟加拉之间的林间丘陵和河谷中，靠近辛格布姆的其他首领领地。地方王朝通过家族及其与山地社群的关系统治相邻土地。

english: The Icheda is a river of the central Siberian uplands, among the headwaters between the Angara and Lena drainage systems. Forested ridges separate its tributaries from neighbouring rivers, including the Kuta and Bereya. This is a landscape of taiga and long winters, where waterways cut through the plateau and flow again after the seasonal thaw.
simp_chinese: 伊切达河位于中西伯利亚高地的安加拉与勒拿水系源头地带。森林覆盖的山脊分隔其支流与库塔、别列亚等邻近河流。这里是泰加林和漫长冬季的土地，水道切穿高原，在季节性融化后重新流动。

english:
Icheon lay in Gyeonggi, south-east of the Joseon capital. The end of Goryeo and the beginning of Joseon changed its administrative standing: it was raised to Namcheon County in 1390, became Icheon-hyeon in 1392, and received a hyeongam magistrate under the reorganisation of 1413. In 1444 it was elevated to a dohobu, governed by a busa.

The local hyanggyo, founded in 1401, made Confucian education and ritual visible in the town. Students previously taught at Anheung Temple were moved to the new school. State support supplied land, books and dependent labour, sustaining both instruction and sacrifices to the sages. In later Joseon the school's teaching role declined while commemorative rites retained importance. Administration and learning therefore gave Icheon institutions linking its local community with the dynasty's official culture.
simp_chinese:
利川位于朝鲜都城东南的京畿地区。高丽末年至朝鲜初年的建置变动，先后改变其行政地位：1390年升称南川郡，1392年改为利川县，1413年行政整顿时设置县监，1444年又升为都护府，由府使治理。

1401年建立的乡校，使儒学教育与礼仪在城镇中有了正式场所。原先在安兴寺学习的学生迁入新校，国家给予土地、典籍和奴婢等支持，维持教学与祭祀先贤。朝鲜后期，乡校教学功能逐渐减弱，祭享仍保持重要地位。行政机构与学校共同将地方社群接入王朝的官方文化，形成超出农田和市场之外的城镇生活中心。

english:
Ichera stands on the left bank of the Lena, just upstream from the mouth of the river of the same name. The tributary runs through wooded country before joining the great river, placing the settlement beside one of eastern Siberia's principal routes. Its Russian documentary history reaches back to the early eighteenth century: an assessment book of 1707 records the village as Ichora, and in 1723 Icherskaya contained two households of arable peasants. Cultivation thus formed part of this small riverside settlement alongside the surrounding forest economy.

The tributary also drew administrative attention. In 1789 the communal office at Chechuysk reported that it had supplied thirty men for Lieutenant and surveyor Akhryatkin's journey along the Ichera. The river was subsequently named in the 1792 description of the Irkutsk viceroyalty. These records place the locality within the work of taxation, surveying and the mobilisation of labour in the Lena country. The small village and its tributary linked a cultivated riverbank to a much larger wooded basin. Movement along the Lena and expeditions into its tributaries made both the settlement and its surrounding country legible to imperial officials.
simp_chinese:
伊切拉位于勒拿河左岸、同名支流汇入口稍上游。支流穿行林地后注入大河，使聚落紧邻西伯利亚东部的一条主要通道。当地俄文文献记录可以追溯到十八世纪初：1707年的赋税簿将村庄记作Ichora，1723年的Icherskaya有两户耕地农民。因此，这个小型河岸居民点在周围森林经济之外，也已有耕作活动。

支流本身也进入行政视野。1789年，切丘伊斯克的乡社机构报告，已为中尉兼测量员阿赫里亚特金沿伊切拉河考察提供三十名人员。1792年的《伊尔库茨克总督区描述》随后记载了这条河。这些材料把地方与勒拿地区的征税、测绘及劳力动员相连。小村和支流连接着可耕作河岸与更广大的森林流域；沿勒拿河的往来，以及深入支流的行程，也使聚落和周围土地逐渐进入帝国官员的地理与行政记录。

english: Ichihara lies on the eastern shore of Edo Bay in Kazusa. At Yawata, the Hachiman shrine served the local estate and was also associated with the gods of the province as a whole. Medieval documents record the transfer of the office responsible for its Buddhist administration, showing how a shrine's affairs were intertwined with estate rights and the Kamakura government. The settlement around the shrine grew beside the routes and waters of the bay.
simp_chinese: 市原位于上总江户湾东岸。八幡的八幡宫既是地方庄园的守护社，也与全省诸神的祭祀有关。中世纪文书记载了管理神社佛事的别当职转让，显示神社事务与庄园权利及镰仓政权之间的联系。神社周围的聚落依托湾岸水陆交通发展。

english:
The Ichinskiy Coast faces the Sea of Okhotsk on western Kamchatka. The peninsula's rivers and shores were home to Indigenous communities long before Russian expansion. Itelmen livelihoods depended heavily on fishing, especially salmon; river settlements and fishing grounds connected families to particular waterways.

Russian expeditions reached Kamchatka in the late seventeenth century, bringing new forts and demands for fur tribute. Resistance, coercion and disease accompanied the imposition of Russian rule. In the eighteenth century sea routes connected western Kamchatka with Okhotsk, while Stepan Krasheninnikov's account described the peninsula and its inhabitants.
simp_chinese:
伊钦斯基海岸位于堪察加西侧，面向鄂霍次克海。俄国扩张之前，半岛河流和海岸早已是原住民的家园。伊捷尔缅人的生计高度依赖捕鱼，尤其是鲑鱼；河边聚落和渔场将家庭与具体水道联系起来。

十七世纪末，俄国远征进入堪察加，带来新的堡垒和毛皮贡税要求。俄国统治的建立伴随着抵抗、强制与疾病。十八世纪，海路连接堪察加西岸和鄂霍次克，斯捷潘·克拉申宁尼科夫的著作也记述了半岛及其居民。

english:
Ichirouganaim is the island of Barbados, the easternmost of the Lesser Antilles. Its coral limestone hills rise above a coast fringed by reefs. Indigenous peoples knew the island long before English settlers arrived; their Caribbean world was disrupted by European incursions and forced removals. By the seventeenth century Barbados had become a centre of English settlement and Atlantic plantation agriculture.

Sugar plantations depended on the labour of enslaved Africans, whose resistance challenged the authority of the planters. In April 1816 an uprising began at Bayleys plantation and spread through several parishes. Bussa, a ranger on the estate, was among its leaders and was killed in the fighting. The rebellion was suppressed, but news of it reached Britain amid a growing debate over slavery. Emancipation came under the legislation of 1833, followed by a period of compulsory apprenticeship.

The later city of Bridgetown lies here.
simp_chinese:
伊奇鲁加纳姆即巴巴多斯岛，是小安的列斯群岛最东端的岛屿。珊瑚石灰岩构成的丘陵高出海岸，岸边环绕着礁石。英国人定居之前，原住民早已熟悉这座岛；欧洲人的入侵与强迫迁徙则破坏了他们的加勒比世界。到十七世纪，巴巴多斯成为英国定居和大西洋种植园农业的中心。

甘蔗种植园依赖受奴役的非洲人劳动，而他们的反抗不断挑战种植园主的权威。1816年4月，起义从贝利斯种植园爆发，蔓延至数个教区。庄园巡管布萨是领导者之一，战死于战斗中。起义虽遭镇压，消息却传到英国，成为当地废奴争论的一部分。1833年的立法带来解放，随后仍有一段强制学徒期。

后来的布里奇顿即位于此地。

english:
Ichishi formed part of the country ruled by the Kitabatake governors of Ise. Akiyoshi became governor in 1338; after Northern Court forces captured Tamaru Castle in 1342, the family is said to have moved its headquarters to mountainous Tage, building a residence and Kiriyama Castle. Their power subsequently extended from Ichishi southwards, and into neighbouring Iga and southern Yamato.

The family retained its governorship after the reunification of the Northern and Southern Courts and developed into a provincial warrior house. Tage nevertheless maintained a courtly character. Goods and cultural influences arrived from Kyoto, Yamato, Owari and Mino, while the residence's garden, associated with Hosokawa Takakuni, is thought to date from around 1521. This combination of mountain stronghold and cultivated residence ended in 1576, when Oda Nobunaga's advance brought the Kitabatake family's roughly two hundred and forty years at Tage to a close.
simp_chinese:
一志属于伊势国司北畠氏势力所及的地区。北畠显能于1338年出任伊势国司；1342年北朝军攻陷田丸城后，北畠氏据传不久便把据点迁入山间的多气，营建宅邸与雾山城。其势力随后从一志向南伸展，也涉及邻近的伊贺及大和南部。

南北朝统一后，北畠氏保住了国司地位，逐渐成为统治地方的武家。多气仍保有浓厚的公家文化色彩：京都、大和、尾张和美浓的物品与文化不断传入，与细川高国有关的宅邸庭园则被认为约建于1521年。这座山城与雅致宅邸并存的据点，最终在1576年织田信长扩张势力时覆亡，北畠氏在多气延续约二百四十年的历史也随之结束。

english:
Ichisi was a chiefdom in the Ocmulgee River country of central Georgia. Its principal town is usually associated with the Lamar Mounds and Village site. The settlement contained houses within a palisade and two distinctive monuments: a platform mound and a second mound with a spiral ascent. These earthworks belonged to a community with its own history of construction and occupation before the Spanish expedition arrived.

Hernando de Soto's party passed through the Ichisi country in the spring of 1540. On 1 April, members of the expedition erected a cross and held a religious service at the principal town, before continuing east. The town was densely occupied in the fifteenth and sixteenth centuries, and its mounds were already old when the Spaniards came.
simp_chinese:
伊奇西是佐治亚中部奥克马尔吉河地域的一处酋邦。其首府通常与拉马尔土丘及村落遗址相联系。聚落的木栅内有房屋和两座形制鲜明的土丘：一座为平台丘，另一座以螺旋坡道上升。这些建筑属于一个在西班牙远征队抵达以前便有自身营建与居住历史的社群。

埃尔南多·德索托一行于1540年春经过伊奇西。4月1日，远征队在首府立起十字架并举行宗教仪式，随后向东前进。城镇在十五至十六世纪居住密集，西班牙人到来时，土丘已经存在多时。

english: Ichitki is the Wayuunaiki name of a settlement in the dry Guajira peninsula, in the country of the Wayuu people. Wells, seasonal waterholes and springs are important places in a landscape where rainfall is uncertain. Wayuu families organise their lives through ties of kinship and territory, while routes across the peninsula link inland communities with the coast. Salt from northern Guajira historically travelled along routes towards Ichitki and Riohacha.
simp_chinese: 伊奇特基是瓜希拉半岛干旱地区一处聚落的瓦尤语名称，位于瓦尤人的土地上。降雨不稳定，水井、季节性水塘和泉水因此是当地的重要地点。瓦尤家庭通过亲属和土地关系组织生活，横穿半岛的道路将内陆社群与海岸联系起来。瓜希拉北部的盐过去沿路线运往伊奇特基和里奥阿查。

english: Ichnia is an old town of the left-bank Ukrainian countryside, recorded from the fourteenth century. In the later sixteenth century it belonged to Prince Kostiantyn Vyshnevetsky, and its inhabitants joined the Cossack rising led by Bohdan Khmelnytskyi. In 1648–49 Ichnia briefly became the centre of its own regiment. Its Cossacks took part in the siege of Zbarazh in 1649; that year the regiment was absorbed into the Pryluky Regiment as two companies. Ichnia continued as a company town under the Hetmanate, its local offices linking the settlement to the regimental administration.
simp_chinese: 伊奇尼亚是乌克兰左岸乡间的古镇，十四世纪已有记载。十六世纪后期，它属于科斯蒂扬丁·维什涅韦茨基亲王；居民后来参加了博赫丹·赫梅利尼茨基领导的哥萨克起义。1648至1649年，伊奇尼亚短暂成为自己军团的中心。当地哥萨克参加了1649年的兹巴拉日围攻；同年该团被并入普里卢基团，成为两个百人队。盖特曼国时期，伊奇尼亚继续作为百人队驻地，地方机构将聚落与军团行政联系起来。

english: Ich'ŏn lies in the mountainous interior west of P'yŏnggang, where the Imjin River and its tributaries pass through valleys and small basins. Under Koryŏ it was a dependency of Tongju, later Ch'ŏrwŏn. The Joseon government transferred it to Kangwŏn in 1413. It was raised to the rank of a protectorate in 1608, reduced again in 1623 and promoted once more in 1687.
simp_chinese: 伊川位于平康以西的内陆山地，临津江及其支流流经河谷和小盆地。高丽时期，它是东州的属县，东州后来称为铁原。朝鲜政府于1413年将伊川划入江原道。1608年它升为都护府，1623年降为县，1687年又再次升格。

english: Ichugán stands above the Chaupihuaranga valley near Yanahuanca in the central Andes. The stone complex is associated with the Yaro culture and is thought to date from around the ninth century. Circular buildings with interior corbels rise on the slope, some with two storeys, while stairways connect different parts of the settlement. A lookout commands the river and ravine below. Archaeologists have also recorded ovens, possibly used in making pottery, and irrigation channels serving cultivated terraces. Circular towers with features associated with Inca construction point to later activity at the site. Together the buildings and terraces reveal a community that shaped the steep mountainside for habitation and cultivation before the Spanish conquest.
simp_chinese: 伊丘甘位于安第斯中部亚纳万卡附近，俯瞰乔皮瓦兰加河谷。这处石造建筑群与亚罗文化有关，据信可追溯至约九世纪。带有内侧挑檐的圆形建筑矗立在坡地上，有些高达两层，阶梯连接聚落各处。瞭望处可俯视下方河流和峡谷。考古人员还记录了可能用于制作陶器的炉窑，以及为耕作梯田供水的灌溉渠道。具有印加建筑特征的圆塔则显示遗址后来仍有活动。建筑与梯田共同展现了西班牙征服之前，当地社群如何改造陡峭山坡以供居住和耕种。

english: Ichukanai is associated with Icaño, in the dry plains east of the mountains of Catamarca. One interpretation derives its name from a Quechua expression for burned grass. The settlement lies in a region where streams descending from the mountains meet the arid lowlands. Spanish settlement in the surrounding country developed within the colonial jurisdiction of Tucumán, among communities whose Indigenous place names endured.
simp_chinese: 伊楚卡奈与卡塔马卡山地以东干燥平原上的伊卡尼奥有关。一种解释认为其名称来自克丘亚语中“烧焦的草”。这里位于山间溪流进入干旱低地的地区。周围的西班牙聚落在殖民时代的图库曼辖区内发展，当地社群的原住民地名则保留下来。

english: Ichuna lay in the upper Tambo country of the southern Peruvian Andes, where colonial life was closely tied to mining and Christian parishes. The date commonly given for Spanish recognition of Ichuna as a mining settlement, an asiento minero, is 19 April 1562. Ecclesiastical boundaries changed later in the colonial period: in 1793 Bishop Pedro Chaves de la Rosa separated Ichuna from the parish of Carumas and gave the locality its own parish. This reorganisation belonged to a wider network of doctrines governed from Arequipa.
simp_chinese: 伊丘纳位于秘鲁南部安第斯的坦博河上游地区，殖民时期的生活与采矿和基督教堂区紧密相关。通常所说西班牙人承认伊丘纳为矿业聚落（asiento minero）的日期是1562年4月19日。殖民时期后期，教会边界再次变化：1793年，主教佩德罗·查韦斯·德拉罗萨将伊丘纳从卡鲁马斯堂区分出，使其拥有独立堂区。这次调整属于由阿雷基帕治理的更大教区网络。

english: Ichuveem is a river of northern Chukotka that flows into Chaun Bay. Its Chukchi name has been interpreted as “river with rich pastures.” Tributaries gather water from the surrounding uplands before the river reaches the Arctic coast, crossing a landscape of tundra and long winters. The valley and its pastures belong to a northern country where people travelled with reindeer across wide distances.
simp_chinese: 伊丘维姆是楚科奇北部的一条河流，注入恰温湾。其楚科奇语名称被解释为“牧场丰饶的河”。支流从周围高地汇集水流，河流穿过苔原与漫长冬季统治的土地，最终抵达北冰洋沿岸。河谷及其牧场属于辽阔的北方，人们曾带着驯鹿跨越这里漫长的距离。

english: Ickari Kitsu recalls Indigenous names recorded for Nebraska's Loup River. Its branches drain the Sandhills and flow eastward to join the Platte, crossing a country of grass-covered dunes and river valleys. The river was known to the Pawnee, whose villages and farming lands lay along waterways of the central plains. Its French name, Loup, means “wolf,” a name also associated with the Skidi Pawnee.
simp_chinese: 伊卡里基苏使人想起内布拉斯加州卢普河所记录的原住民名称。河流的支流排泄沙丘地区的水，向东流经覆盖草木的沙丘和河谷，汇入普拉特河。波尼人熟悉这条河，其村落和农田分布在中央平原的水道沿线。法语河名“卢普”意为“狼”，这一名称也与斯基迪波尼人有关。

english:
Idah stands on the eastern bank of the Niger and was the capital of the Igala kingdom. Its ruler, the Attah, held political and sacred authority, supported by titled officials and ties to local communities. Traditions among several peoples along the river trace the descent of their rulers to Idah, reflecting the reach of its court beyond the town itself.

The Igala kingdom lay between the Niger and Benue rivers, whose confluence helped bring it into contact with a wide range of neighbouring peoples. Idah's position linked the court to communities along the Niger, while routes inland connected it with other societies. Farming, fishing and trade sustained life in this riverine region, where political authority and exchange crossed a landscape of many languages and communities.
simp_chinese:
伊达位于尼日尔河东岸，是伊加拉王国的都城。称为阿塔的君主兼有政治和神圣权威，其统治依靠有头衔的官员及同地方社群的联系。沿河多个族群的传统将各自统治者的血统追溯到伊达，反映出宫廷在城镇以外的影响。

伊加拉王国位于尼日尔河与贝努埃河之间，两河汇合的地理位置使它得以与众多邻近族群接触。伊达的河畔位置联系着宫廷与沿河社群，通往内陆的道路则连接其他社会。农业、捕鱼和贸易支撑着这片河流地区的生活，政治权威与交换活动穿行于语言和社群多样的地域。

english: Idanha-a-Nova grew in the frontier country of Beira, not far from the older settlement of Idanha-a-Velha. In 1187 the Templar Gualdim Pais built a castle here, and Sancho I granted a charter in 1201 to encourage settlement and defense. Afonso II confirmed it in 1219, distinguishing the new Idanha from the old. As the new town grew and the older place declined, Manuel I granted Idanha-a-Nova another charter in 1510. Its castle was recorded by Duarte de Armas in his book of fortresses.
simp_chinese: 新伊达尼亚兴起于贝拉边境地区，离更古老的旧伊达尼亚不远。1187年，圣殿骑士瓜尔丁·派什在此修建城堡；桑乔一世于1201年颁发特许状，鼓励居民定居并保卫土地。阿方索二世于1219年确认特许状，将新伊达尼亚与旧地加以区分。新城逐渐发展、旧城衰落之后，曼努埃尔一世于1510年再次授予它特许状。杜阿尔特·德阿尔马什在《堡垒之书》中绘记了这里的城堡。

english:
Idar lies among the granite hills of northeastern Gujarat, where a rocky height bears the remains of a fort above the town. The surrounding country formed a frontier between Gujarat and Rajasthan, and its rulers held a position among the Rajput houses of the region. The fort’s steep natural setting gave its chiefs a stronghold from which to command the approaches through the hills.

In the eighteenth century the political order of Gujarat shifted as Mughal authority weakened. In 1729 Anand Singh and Rai Singh, brothers of the ruler of Jodhpur, established themselves at Idar by force. Their family held the state through subsequent conflicts involving neighbouring chiefs and the Marathas. The fortified hill remained the centre of a local principality amid the wider changes of power in western India.
simp_chinese:
伊达尔位于古吉拉特东北部花岗岩丘陵之间，镇上一座岩山保留着堡垒遗迹。周围地区是古吉拉特与拉贾斯坦之间的边区，当地统治者属于该地区的拉杰普特家族。堡垒陡峭的天然地势使首领得以据守高地，控制穿越丘陵的通道。

十八世纪莫卧儿权威衰落，古吉拉特的政治秩序随之变化。1729年，焦特布尔统治者的兄弟阿南德·辛格和拉伊·辛格凭武力在伊达尔立足。他们的家族在此后涉及邻近首领及马拉塔人的冲突中维持了邦国。设防山丘仍是地方公国的中心，周围西印度地区的权力却不断变化。

english: Idensalmi, or Iisalmi, lies in the lake country of northern Savolax. Its parish was separated from Kuopio in 1627, and settlement grew around the church and the waterways. Between Lake Iijärvi and Lake Porovesi lies Koljonvirta, named for an early settler, Lauri Koljonen. During the Finnish War, Swedish and Russian forces fought at Koljonvirta in October and November 1808. On 27 October Swedish troops under Colonel Sandels defeated a Russian attack at the crossing. The fighting destroyed nearby farms, including the house at Koljonvirta, and left a lasting mark on the landscape of fields and shores.
simp_chinese: 伊登萨尔米的芬兰语名为伊萨尔米，位于萨沃拉克斯北部的湖区。1627年，当地教区从库奥皮奥分出，聚落围绕教堂和水道发展。伊耶尔维湖与波罗韦西湖之间的科尔约河得名于早期定居者劳里·科尔约宁。芬兰战争期间，瑞典与俄国军队于1808年10月和11月在科尔约河交战。10月27日，桑德尔斯上校率领的瑞典军队在渡口击退俄军进攻。战斗毁坏了附近农庄，包括科尔约河畔的住宅，也在田野和湖岸景观中留下持久印记。

english: The Ider River rises in the Khangai Mountains and flows northeast through western Mongolia. After receiving the rocky Chuluut River, it meets the Delger Mörön to form the Selenge, whose waters continue to Lake Baikal. The Ider remains frozen for roughly half the year. Its course links the high valleys of the Khangai with the broader river country to the north.
simp_chinese: 伊德尔河发源于杭爱山，向东北流经蒙古西部。它接纳多石的楚鲁特河后，与德勒格尔木伦河汇合成色楞格河，河水继续流入贝加尔湖。伊德尔河一年约有半数时间封冻，其河道将杭爱山高地河谷与北方更广阔的河流地区连接起来。

english:
The salt flats of Idjil, near the northern end of Mauritania's Adrar country, supplied the caravans of the western Sahara. Workers cut the deposit into heavy bars for transport by camel, and enslaved labourers were among those employed at the saltworks. Idjil's salt supported the commerce of Chinguetti, the oasis town that grew into a centre of Islamic learning between the seventeenth and nineteenth centuries. Kunta groups held the saltworks as well as taking part in the trading and scholarly networks of the desert.

The later city of Zouérat lies here.
simp_chinese:
伊吉尔盐沼位于毛里塔尼亚阿德拉尔地区北端附近，为西撒哈拉的商队提供食盐。工人将盐矿切成沉重的盐条，交由骆驼运走；盐场劳作者中也有被奴役的人。伊吉尔盐业支撑了欣盖提的贸易，这座绿洲城镇在十七至十九世纪发展为伊斯兰学术中心。昆塔群体曾掌控盐场，也参与沙漠中的贸易和学术网络。

后来的祖埃拉特即位于此地。

sources.title: An Economic History of West Afr - A. G. Hopkins.pdf

english: Idkabue is an old name for the country around Attapeu in southern Laos. Local tradition associates the name, said to mean buffalo droppings, with the wild buffalo that once inhabited the area. The land lies east of the Bolaven Plateau in the basin of the Sekong and its tributaries. It became part of the Lao kingdom of Lan Xang and later belonged to the southern kingdom of Champasak.
simp_chinese: 伊卡布是老挝南部阿速坡一带的旧称。据当地传说，这个被解释为「水牛粪」的名字，与昔日生活于此的野水牛有关。这里位于波罗芬高原以东，属于色公河及其支流的流域。此地后来成为老挝澜沧王国的一部分，继而归属南方的占巴塞王国。

english:
Idlib lies amid the olive-growing country southwest of Aleppo. In the early Ottoman period it was a small fief, but its orchards and presses supplied oil for an expanding soap industry. The town became known as Idlib al-Sabun, or Idlib of the Soap, as workshops turned local oil into a product sold in the markets of northern Syria and beyond.

Court records describe a large soapworks built in the northern quarter in 1654–55 by Ahmad and Baha al-Din al-Zahrawi. It had a great copper cauldron and numerous oil storage tanks; the family also endowed a nearby mosque. Oil from neighbouring villages supplied the works, while other presses and soap boilers operated throughout the district. Idlib's soap reached markets including Aleppo, Antioch and Hama, and was carried as far as Istanbul.
simp_chinese:
伊德利卜位于阿勒颇西南的橄榄种植地区。奥斯曼初期，它只是一个小采邑，但果园和榨坊生产的油为不断发展的肥皂业提供原料。当地作坊将橄榄油制成肥皂，销往叙利亚北部及更远的市场，城镇因此获得“肥皂伊德利卜”的称号。

法庭记录记载，艾哈迈德和巴哈丁·扎赫拉维于1654至1655年在北区修建一座大型肥皂作坊，内有巨大的铜锅和许多储油槽；家族还捐建了附近的清真寺。邻近村庄供应橄榄油，地区各处也有其他榨坊和煮皂作坊。伊德利卜肥皂销往阿勒颇、安条克和哈马等市场，远至伊斯坦布尔。

english: Idodomya lies north of Dodoma in the central plateau country known as Ugogo. The Gogo communities of this dry region grew drought-resistant grains and kept cattle, combining cultivation with herding where the rains were uncertain. Ugogo's central communities were linked by kinship with groups farther west and east, whose local identities reflected the varied origins of Gogo clans.
simp_chinese: 伊多杜米亚位于多多马以北、称为乌戈戈的中央高原地区。这里的戈戈社群种植耐旱谷物、饲养牛群，在降雨不稳定的土地上兼营农牧。乌戈戈中部的居民通过亲缘关系与东西两面的群体相连，各地的身份称谓反映了戈戈诸氏族不同的来源。

english:
Idre lies in the mountain and forest country of northwestern Dalarna, close to the Norwegian frontier. Together with neighbouring Särna it once belonged to Norway and was attached to the parish of Elverum. In a wartime expedition from Älvdalen, Swedish forces occupied the two districts in 1644, and they remained under Sweden after the peace of Brömsebro the following year.

Despite Norwegian claims to the area, the precise frontier was not settled until the treaty of 1751. Idre and Särna remained Swedish, while a portion of the old Idre parish east of Lake Femunden went to Norway. An accompanying agreement regulated Sámi rights, including the movement of reindeer across the new boundary. The line divided a mountain landscape whose inhabitants had long travelled between seasonal grounds.
simp_chinese:
伊德勒位于达拉纳西北部山林中，靠近挪威边界。它与邻近的塞尔纳原属挪威，隶属于埃尔韦鲁姆教区。1644年，瑞典军队从埃尔夫达伦出发，占领两地，次年《布勒姆瑟布鲁和约》后它们仍由瑞典控制。

尽管挪威继续主张拥有该地区，确切边界直到1751年条约才获确定。伊德勒和塞尔纳留在瑞典，费蒙湖以东原伊德勒教区的一部分则归挪威。附带协议规定了萨米人的权利，包括带驯鹿跨越新边界。边线划分了一片居民长期往返于季节性牧地之间的山地。

english:
Idrinskoye developed in the southern Siberian country of the Syda and Idra rivers. Tradition says Cossacks founded the village in 1736, and it appears in a 1779 confession register of the Resurrection Church in the Abakan district. The settlement appears under several related spellings, including Idrinskaya, Idra and Idrinskoye.

With the creation of Yenisei province, the village acquired a new administrative role: in 1823 it became the centre of a volost within Minusinsk district. Idrinskoye thus entered the growing civil administration of southern Siberia, after its early ties to the Cossack settlements around Abakan.
simp_chinese:
伊德林斯科耶形成于西伯利亚南部瑟达河与伊德拉河一带。相传1736年哥萨克在此建村，阿巴坎辖区复活教堂1779年的教民告解名册中已有它的名字。聚落在记录中出现过伊德林斯卡亚、伊德拉、伊德林斯科耶等相近写法。

叶尼塞省设立后，这里又获得新的行政职能：1823年，村庄成为米努辛斯克区一个乡的中心。在早期与阿巴坎周围哥萨克聚落相联系之后，伊德林斯科耶由此进入西伯利亚南部逐步发展的地方行政体系。

english: Idy was a settlement on the western coast of Sakhalin, facing the mainland across the narrow strait. Recorded as Yidui or Yidui Gashan in Qing sources, it belonged to a coast whose inhabitants maintained contacts with the lower Amur. Traders from the mainland crossed to Sakhalin with goods from China and exchanged them for furs and other products. The settlement appeared on the Kangxi-era imperial map of the island.
simp_chinese: 伊对是库页岛西岸的一处聚落，隔狭窄海峡与大陆相望。清代文献将它记作伊对或衣堆噶珊，康熙时期的《皇舆全览图》也标出了这一地点。沿岸居民与黑龙江下游保持联系，大陆商人携带中国货物渡海，以换取毛皮等物产。

english:
Ifẹ̀ is the sacred city of the Yoruba, where tradition says Oduduwa descended on a chain to make the earth and where his sons and daughters went out to found the kingdoms of Oyo, Ketu, Owu, Ila Orangun and others. Its Ọọ̀ni is the successor of that line, and the city is called the home of 401 deities, whose festivals still bring the votaries of Obatala and Oduduwa into their yearly rivalry at Itapa.

Ife was a substantial settlement between the twelfth and fourteenth centuries, with houses floored in potsherd pavement. Around 1300 its artists, under the patronage of Obalufon II, whom the Yoruba honour as the patron of brass casting and weaving, made the naturalistic heads and masks in terracotta, stone and copper alloy that peaked between 1200 and 1400. Ife glass beads have been found as far away as Mali, Mauritania and Ghana. After the fourteenth century this production declined as political and economic power shifted to Benin and Oyo, but Ife kept its place as the origin of Yoruba kingship. Benin's own tradition tells that Oranmiyan, Oduduwa's youngest son, left behind a child, Eweka, who became the first Oba of its second dynasty.
simp_chinese:
伊费是约鲁巴人的圣城，传说奥杜杜瓦顺着铁链降下创造大地，他的子女从这里出发，建立了奥约、凯图、奥乌、伊拉·奥兰贡等王国。城中的奥尼是这一世系的继承者，伊费也被称为“四百零一位神灵之家”，奥巴塔拉和奥杜杜瓦的信徒仍在每年的伊塔帕节上重演他们的竞争。

12至14世纪，伊费是一座规模可观的聚落，房屋铺有陶片地面。1300年前后，工匠在奥巴鲁丰二世的庇护下，以陶土、石头和铜合金制作了写实的头像和面具，艺术成就在1200至1400年间达到顶点。奥巴鲁丰二世被约鲁巴人尊为铸铜与织造的守护者。伊费的玻璃珠远至马里、毛里塔尼亚和加纳都有出土。14世纪之后，这类制作渐渐衰落，政治和经济权力转向贝宁和奥约，但伊费仍是约鲁巴王权的源头。贝宁自己的传说讲，奥杜杜瓦的幼子奥兰米扬留下一个孩子埃韦卡，成为贝宁第二王朝的第一位奥巴。

english: Iferouane is an oasis in the northern Aïr, in the Ighazar valley near the Tamgak range. Mountain valleys interrupt the surrounding Sahara, and water permits gardens and settlement in a region otherwise dominated by rock and sand. The Aïr has long been part of the country of the Tuareg, whose routes cross these mountains and the desert beyond.
simp_chinese: 伊费鲁安是阿伊尔北部的一处绿洲，位于塔姆加克山脉附近的伊加扎尔河谷。山谷打破了周围撒哈拉的荒漠景观，水源使园地和聚落得以存在。阿伊尔长期是图阿雷格人的土地，他们的道路穿越群山并通向更远的沙漠。

english: Ifni lies on Morocco's Atlantic shore, south of the Sous and opposite the Canary Islands. The coast belongs to the country of the Ait Baamrane, whose communities inhabit the hills and valleys near the sea. Cliffs, dry uplands and fishing waters give this stretch of coast a distinct character between the Atlantic and the lands approaching the Sahara.
simp_chinese: 伊夫尼位于摩洛哥大西洋海岸，苏斯以南，与加那利群岛隔海相望。这片海岸属于艾特巴阿姆兰人的土地，他们的社群居住在临海的山丘与河谷之间。峭壁、干燥高地和渔场，使大西洋与撒哈拉边缘之间的这段海岸别具特色。

english: Ifrane of the Anti-Atlas, also known as Oufrane, is an oasis in the mountains of southern Morocco. Its palm groves and settlements lie on the southern side of the range. The oasis was home to a Jewish community with a synagogue and burial ground, alongside the region’s Muslim inhabitants. Local tradition remembers Oufrane as one of the old Jewish communities of Morocco, though its earliest origins are uncertain.
simp_chinese: 小阿特拉斯山的伊夫兰又称乌夫兰，是摩洛哥南部山区的一处绿洲。棕榈林和聚落位于山脉南侧；这里曾有犹太社区，拥有犹太会堂和墓地，与当地穆斯林居民共同生活。地方传说将乌夫兰视为摩洛哥古老的犹太社区之一，但其最早的起源并不确定。

english: Iga lies in a basin enclosed by the hills between Ise and the central provinces. In the late sixteenth century its local warriors formed a league known as the Iga Sōkoku Ikki, resisting outside domination. They repelled an attack by Oda Nobukatsu in 1579, but Oda Nobunaga's larger invasion in 1581 devastated the province. Under later Tōdō rule, men from Iga served their lord on journeys to Edo, drawing on skills that became associated with the Iga ninja.
simp_chinese: 伊贺位于群山环绕的盆地，介于伊势与中央诸国之间。十六世纪后期，当地武士组成伊贺惣国一揆，抵抗外来统治。1579年，他们击退织田信雄的进攻；1581年，织田信长率大军入侵，使伊贺遭受重创。后来藤堂氏统治下，伊贺人随藩主往返江户，运用后来与伊贺忍者相联系的技艺。

english: Igan lies among the waterways of the lower Rajang delta on Borneo's northwestern coast. The delta divides into channels that wind through wetlands before reaching the South China Sea. Melanau communities inhabited the coastal river country, where people identified themselves with particular rivers and settlements. Boats could pass between these waterways and the sea, linking the delta's scattered communities.
simp_chinese: 伊干位于婆罗洲西北岸拉让河下游三角洲的水道之间。三角洲分成多条河汊，蜿蜒穿过湿地后注入南中国海。梅拉瑙社群居住在沿海河流地区，人们以各自的河流和聚落表明身份。船只可在水道与大海之间往来，连接三角洲分散的社群。

english: Igaraçu is a channel of the Parnaíba delta, on whose banks the settlement of Parnaíba grew around the Porto das Barcas. The river gave the port access to the Atlantic and to the cattle country of the interior. In the eighteenth century, establishments preparing dried beef brought trade and population to the waterfront. Their products were shipped to Pernambuco, Bahia, Rio de Janeiro and Pará, while warehouses and a small chapel rose beside the port.
simp_chinese: 伊加拉苏是帕尔纳伊巴河三角洲的一条水道，帕尔纳伊巴聚落在其岸边的巴尔卡斯港周围发展起来。河流使港口既能通向大西洋，也能联系内陆牧牛地区。十八世纪，制作干肉的作坊为河岸带来贸易与人口，产品运往伯南布哥、巴伊亚、里约热内卢和帕拉；港口旁也建起仓库和一座小礼拜堂。

sources.title: pi conjundo historico e paisagistico de parnaiba.pdf

english:
Igbo-Ukwu lies in the forested country east of the Niger, where craftspeople of the ninth century made intricate vessels and ornaments of bronze by the lost-wax process, centuries before other known bronzes of the region. A burial known as Igbo Richard contained a person of high standing with regalia and thousands of beads, Igbo Isaiah held sacred vessels and further insignia, and Igbo Jonah held pottery, bronzes and animal remains. Some of the materials show trade reaching as far as the Nile valley.

The art of Igbo-Ukwu is linked with the Kingdom of Nri, a priest-kingdom of the northern Igbo ruled by the Eze Nri. Nri spread its influence not by arms but by sending out converts, called mbùríchi, and winning allegiance through ritual oaths. Each new Eze Nri was chosen only after an interregnum of at least seven years. By the late sixteenth century Nri influence reached Igbo settlements on the west bank of the Niger and communities touched by the Benin Empire. From the early eighteenth century it declined, pressed by Benin and the Igala and by the slave trade, while the Aro Confederacy at Arochukwu, founded after 1640, took over the commerce and the oracle of Ibini Ukpabi.
simp_chinese:
伊博乌库位于尼日尔河以东的森林地区，9世纪的工匠在此以失蜡法制作精美的铜器和饰物，比该地区其他已知铜器早了几个世纪。被称为“伊博理查德”的墓葬中，一位地位显赫的人随葬有礼器和数以千计的珠子；“伊博以赛亚”遗址藏有圣器与其他仪物；“伊博约拿”则出土陶器、铜器和动物遗骸。部分材料显示这里的贸易远达尼罗河谷。

伊博乌库的艺术与恩里王国相联系，那是北部伊博人的一个祭司王国，由恩里王（埃泽·恩里）统治。恩里扩大影响靠的不是武力，而是派出名为“姆布里奇”的皈依者，并通过仪式性的誓言赢得效忠；每位新的恩里王要在至少七年的空位期后才选出。到16世纪后期，恩里的影响已到达尼日尔河西岸的伊博聚落，以及受贝宁帝国影响的社区。18世纪初起，它在贝宁、伊加拉和奴隶贸易的压力下衰落，而1640年之后在阿罗丘库建立的阿罗联盟，则接管了贸易和伊比尼·乌克帕比神谕。

english:
Igboho was a royal seat of Oyo during a time when its rulers had left their older capital. Yoruba traditions tell how the Nupe drove the Alaafin from Oyo Ile and how the exiled court sought refuge towards Borgu before establishing itself at Igboho. Four rulers are remembered here, and royal tombs preserve the association between the town and the dynasty.

At Igboho, Oyo's rulers rebuilt their strength and fought against the Nupe and Borgu. The reigns of Orompoto and Ajiboyede were remembered for military successes. Tradition credits the Alaafin Abipa with leading the return to Oyo Ile, after which the kingdom expanded. Igboho remained important even after the court departed, a reminder that Oyo's rise was preceded by a period of displacement and recovery.
simp_chinese:
伊格博霍曾是奥约统治者离开旧都期间的王室驻地。约鲁巴传统讲述，努佩人迫使阿拉芬离开奥约伊莱，流亡宫廷向博尔古方向寻求庇护，最终在伊格博霍建立驻地。当地记忆中有四位君主在此统治，王陵保留着城镇与王朝之间的联系。

在伊格博霍，奥约统治者重整力量，与努佩和博尔古交战。人们记得奥龙波托和阿吉博耶德在位时取得的军事胜利。传统认为，阿拉芬阿比帕率领人们返回奥约伊莱，此后王国开始扩张。宫廷离开之后，伊格博霍仍然重要，提醒人们奥约的崛起之前曾经历流亡与恢复。

english: Iğdır lies in the plain between Mount Ararat and the Araks. Its medieval predecessor, known in Armenian as Tsolakert, occupied a defensible site nearer the mountain than the later town. The fortress was taken by Seljuk forces in the eleventh century and became part of the district of Surmari. A severe earthquake in 1664 destroyed the old settlement; survivors moved down to the plain, where a new Iğdır took shape.
simp_chinese: 伊迪尔位于亚拉腊山与阿拉斯河之间的平原上。它的中世纪前身在亚美尼亚语中称为措拉凯尔特，坐落在比后来的城镇更靠近山麓、易于防守的地方。十一世纪，塞尔柱军队夺取堡垒，使其成为苏尔马里地区的一部分。1664年的强烈地震摧毁了旧聚落，幸存者迁往平原，在那里形成了新的伊迪尔。

english: Igiliz lies in the Anti-Atlas of southern Morocco, amid the mountains inhabited by the Hargha. It was the birthplace of Ibn Tumart, the religious leader whose teaching gave rise to the Almohad movement in the twelfth century. A cave and fortified mountain site became associated with the movement’s beginnings. The Almohads went on to overthrow the Almoravids and establish a powerful empire in the Maghreb and al-Andalus.
simp_chinese: 伊吉利兹位于摩洛哥南部的小阿特拉斯山中，处在哈尔加人居住的山区。它是伊本·图马尔特的出生地；这位宗教领袖的教导在十二世纪催生了穆瓦希德运动。当地一处洞穴和设防山地遗址与这一运动的起源紧密相连。穆瓦希德人后来推翻穆拉比特王朝，在马格里布和安达卢斯建立了强大的帝国。

english: Igiugig stands where the Kvichak River flows out of Lake Iliamna in southwestern Alaska. Its Yup'ik name evokes a throat swallowing water, an image of the river drawing water from the lake. Kiatagmuit people from Kaskanak, farther down the Kvichak, used Igiugig as a summer fishing camp. The river carries the lake's waters westward toward Bristol Bay, along a route followed by returning salmon.
simp_chinese: 伊吉乌吉格位于阿拉斯加西南部，坐落在克维查克河流出伊利亚姆纳湖的地方。其尤皮克语名称让人联想到吞水的喉咙，形容河流将湖水引走。克维查克河下游卡斯卡纳克的基亚塔格缪特人曾把这里用作夏季渔营。河水向西流往布里斯托尔湾，鲑鱼则沿着这条水道洄游。

english: Igli is an oasis at the meeting of the Guir and Zouzfana, whose waters join to form the Saoura. The valley runs south through the desert beside the dunes of the Grand Erg Occidental. Palm groves and cultivated plots mark the places where water can support settlement in this otherwise arid country.
simp_chinese: 伊格利是吉尔河与祖兹法纳河交汇处的一片绿洲，两条河在这里汇成萨乌拉河。河谷沿西部大沙海的沙丘向南穿过荒漠。棕榈林和耕地标示着这片干旱土地上水源能够支持聚落的地方。

english: Iglunga is an Inuit settlement on a small island off the eastern coast of Baffin Island, at the southern entrance to Bon Accord Harbour. Nearby Iglunga Island and other islands lie in the waters of Cumberland Sound, among fjords that cut into the mountainous coast. The sheltered passages and deep inlets form part of an Arctic seascape shaped by the long winters and seasonal ice of the northern Atlantic.
simp_chinese: 伊格隆加是巴芬岛东岸外小岛上的因纽特人聚落，位于邦阿科尔港南入口。附近的伊格隆加岛及其他岛屿散布在坎伯兰湾水域，峡湾深入多山的海岸。受岛屿遮蔽的水道和深长的海湾构成北大西洋北部的北极海岸景观，漫长冬季和季节性海冰塑造着这里的环境。

english: Igmu lies near the James River in the eastern Dakota plains, where Foster Creek joins the river north of the later site of Huron. The James flows south through a broad, gently sloping valley before reaching the Missouri. Its low gradient allows the river to wind across the plain and spill into surrounding low ground. The tributary creeks drain prairie country on either side of its long course.
simp_chinese: 伊格穆靠近达科他东部平原上的詹姆斯河。福斯特溪在后来休伦城址以北汇入这条河；詹姆斯河向南穿过宽阔而坡度平缓的河谷，最终流入密苏里河。微小的高差使河道在平原上蜿蜒，河水也会漫入周围低地。支流溪涧汇集长河两侧草原的水流。

english:
